package main

import (
        "context"
        "encoding/binary"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "log"
        "math"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/signal"
        "sync"
        "syscall"
        "time"

        _ "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
        "github.com/gin-contrib/cors"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "github.com/gorilla/websocket"
        "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
        "github.com/joho/godotenv"

        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/repository"
        instrumentRepo "algo/internal/modules/instrument/infrastructure/persistence/clickhouse"
)

var (
        // Map to store active WebSocket connections
        clients = make(map[*websocket.Conn]bool)
        // Mutex to protect clients map
        clientsMutex sync.Mutex
        // Map to store subscribed instruments
        subscribedInstruments = make(map[string]bool)
        // ClickHouse database connection
        chDB *sqlx.DB
        // Instrument repository
        instrumentRepository repository.InstrumentRepository
)

// Constants for request and feed codes
const (
        RequestCodeSubscribe   = 15
        RequestCodeUnsubscribe = 16
        RequestCodeDisconnect  = 12

        FeedCodeTicker     = 2
        FeedCodeQuote      = 4
        FeedCodeOI         = 5
        FeedCodePrevClose  = 6
        FeedCodeFull       = 8
        FeedCodeDisconnect = 50
)

// InstrumentRequest represents the structure for subscribing to instruments
type InstrumentRequest struct {
        RequestCode     int              `json:"RequestCode"`
        InstrumentCount int              `json:"InstrumentCount"`
        InstrumentList  []InstrumentInfo `json:"InstrumentList"`
}

// InstrumentInfo represents information about a single instrument
type InstrumentInfo struct {
        ExchangeSegment string `json:"ExchangeSegment"`
        SecurityId      string `json:"SecurityId"`
}

// DisconnectRequest represents the structure for disconnecting from the WebSocket
type DisconnectRequest struct {
        RequestCode int `json:"RequestCode"`
}

// WebSocket upgrader configuration
var wsUpgrader = websocket.Upgrader{
        ReadBufferSize:  1024,
        WriteBufferSize: 1024,
        // Allow connections from any origin
        CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool {
                return true
        },
}

// WebSocket client configuration
var wsDialer = websocket.DefaultDialer

// Upstream connection for market data
var upstreamConn *websocket.Conn

func main() {
        // Load environment variables
        if err := godotenv.Load(); err != nil {
                log.Println("Warning: .env file not found")
        }

        // Initialize database connection
        if err := initDB(); err != nil {
                log.Printf("Error initializing database: %v", err)
                // Continue without database connection
        }

        // Set Gin mode
        gin.SetMode(getEnv("GIN_MODE", "debug"))

        // Initialize router
        router := gin.Default()

        // Setup CORS
        setupCORS(router)

        // Setup middleware
        setupMiddleware(router)

        // Setup WebSocket routes
        wsRouter := router.Group("/ws")
        setupWebSocketRoutes(wsRouter)

        // Setup API routes for live data
        apiRouter := router.Group("/api/live")
        setupAPIRoutes(apiRouter)

        // Get port from environment or use default
        port := getEnv("WS_PORT", "9091")
        serverAddr := fmt.Sprintf(":%s", port)

        // Create a server with graceful shutdown
        server := &http.Server{
                Addr:    serverAddr,
                Handler: router,
        }

        // Connect to upstream WebSocket server
        go connectToUpstreamWebSocket()

        // Start the server in a goroutine
        go func() {
                log.Printf("WebSocket server started on port %s", port)
                if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
                        log.Fatalf("Server error: %s", err)
                }
        }()

        // Wait for interrupt signal to gracefully shut down the server
        quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
        signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
        <-quit

        log.Println("Shutting down WebSocket server...")

        // Send disconnect request to upstream server if connected
        if upstreamConn != nil {
                disconnectRequest := DisconnectRequest{
                        RequestCode: RequestCodeDisconnect,
                }
                if err := upstreamConn.WriteJSON(disconnectRequest); err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error sending disconnect request: %v", err)
                }
        }

        // Create a deadline for server shutdown
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
        defer cancel()

        // Shut down the server
        if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
                log.Fatal("Server forced to shutdown:", err)
        }

        log.Println("WebSocket server exited properly")
}

// initDB initializes the ClickHouse database connection
func initDB() error {
        // Get database connection details from environment variables

        // Create DSN for ClickHouse
        conn := "clickhouse://admin:admin@localhost:9000"
        db, err := sqlx.Connect("clickhouse", conn)

        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error connecting to ClickHouse: %w", err)
        }

        // Test connection
        if err := db.Ping(); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error pinging ClickHouse: %w", err)
        }

        chDB = db
        log.Println("Connected to ClickHouse database")

        // Initialize instrument repository
        instrumentRepository = instrumentRepo.NewInstrumentRepository(chDB)

        return nil
}

// setupCORS configures CORS middleware
func setupCORS(router *gin.Engine) {
        router.Use(cors.New(cors.Config{
                AllowOrigins:     []string{"*"},
                AllowMethods:     []string{"GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"},
                AllowHeaders:     []string{"Origin", "Authorization", "Content-Type"},
                ExposeHeaders:    []string{"Content-Length"},
                AllowCredentials: true,
                MaxAge:           12 * time.Hour,
        }))
}

// setupMiddleware adds global middleware to the router
func setupMiddleware(router *gin.Engine) {
        // Add request ID middleware
        router.Use(requestIDMiddleware())

        // Add logging middleware
        router.Use(loggingMiddleware())

        // Add recovery middleware (already included in gin.Default())
}

// requestIDMiddleware generates a unique request ID for each request
func requestIDMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                c.Writer.Header().Set("X-Request-ID", generateRequestID())
                c.Next()
        }
}

// generateRequestID creates a unique ID for request tracing
func generateRequestID() string {
        // Simple implementation - in production, use a more robust method
        return fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// loggingMiddleware logs request information
func loggingMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Start timer
                start := time.Now()

                // Process request
                c.Next()

                // Log request details
                latency := time.Since(start)
                log.Printf(
                        "[%s] %s %s %d %s",
                        c.Request.Method,
                        c.Request.URL.Path,
                        c.ClientIP(),
                        c.Writer.Status(),
                        latency,
                )
        }
}

// setupWebSocketRoutes sets up routes for WebSocket connections
func setupWebSocketRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Endpoint for client WebSocket connections
        router.GET("/feed", handleClientWebSocket)

        // Endpoint for instrument subscription
        router.POST("/subscribe", handleSubscribeInstruments)
}

// setupAPIRoutes sets up REST API routes for the live data module
func setupAPIRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Endpoint for status check
        router.GET("/status", func(c *gin.Context) {
                c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
                        "status": "live",
                        "time":   time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
                })
        })

        // Endpoint to add instrument subscriptions
        router.POST("/subscribe", func(c *gin.Context) {
                var req struct {
                        Instruments []InstrumentInfo `json:"instruments"`
                }

                if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "Invalid request format"})
                        return
                }

                if len(req.Instruments) == 0 {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "No instruments provided"})
                        return
                }

                // Subscribe to instruments in chunks of 100 as per API limitation
                success := subscribeToInstruments(req.Instruments)

                if success {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
                                "status": "success",
                                "count":  len(req.Instruments),
                        })
                } else {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{
                                "status":  "error",
                                "message": "Failed to subscribe to instruments",
                        })
                }
        })
}

// handleSubscribeInstruments handles WebSocket requests for instrument subscription
func handleSubscribeInstruments(c *gin.Context) {
        var req struct {
                Instruments []InstrumentInfo `json:"instruments"`
        }

        if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "Invalid request format"})
                return
        }

        if len(req.Instruments) == 0 {
                c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "No instruments provided"})
                return
        }

        success := subscribeToInstruments(req.Instruments)

        if success {
                c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
                        "status": "success",
                        "count":  len(req.Instruments),
                })
        } else {
                c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{
                        "status":  "error",
                        "message": "Failed to subscribe to instruments",
                })
        }
}

// handleClientWebSocket handles WebSocket connections from clients
func handleClientWebSocket(c *gin.Context) {
        // Upgrade HTTP connection to WebSocket
        conn, err := wsUpgrader.Upgrade(c.Writer, c.Request, nil)
        if err != nil {
                log.Printf("Error upgrading to WebSocket: %v", err)
                return
        }
        defer conn.Close()

        // Add connection to clients map with mutex lock
        clientsMutex.Lock()
        clients[conn] = true
        clientsMutex.Unlock()

        defer func() {
                clientsMutex.Lock()
                delete(clients, conn)
                clientsMutex.Unlock()
        }()

        log.Printf("New client connected: %s", conn.RemoteAddr())

        // Listen for client messages
        for {
                messageType, message, err := conn.ReadMessage()
                if err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error reading message: %v", err)
                        break
                }

                log.Printf("Received message from client: %s", string(message))

                // Check if it's a subscription request
                if messageType == websocket.TextMessage {
                        var req InstrumentRequest
                        if err := json.Unmarshal(message, &req); err == nil {
                                if req.RequestCode == RequestCodeSubscribe && len(req.InstrumentList) > 0 {
                                        // Forward subscription request to upstream WebSocket
                                        if upstreamConn != nil {
                                                if err := upstreamConn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, message); err != nil {
                                                        log.Printf("Error forwarding subscription to upstream: %v", err)
                                                }
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                }
        }
}

// connectToUpstreamWebSocket establishes connection to the upstream WebSocket server
func connectToUpstreamWebSocket() {
        // Get WebSocket URL and authentication token from environment
        wsURL := getEnv("WS_UPSTREAM_URL", "wss://api-feed.dhan.co")
        wsToken := getEnv("WS_TOKEN", "")
        clientID := getEnv("WS_CLIENT_ID", "")

        // Construct full WebSocket URL with parameters
        fullWSURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s?version=2&token=%s&clientId=%s&authType=2", wsURL, wsToken, clientID)

        log.Printf("Connecting to upstream WebSocket: %s", wsURL)

        // Connect to the upstream WebSocket server
        conn, _, err := wsDialer.Dial(fullWSURL, nil)
        if err != nil {
                log.Printf("Error connecting to upstream WebSocket: %v", err)
                // Retry connection after a delay
                time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
                go connectToUpstreamWebSocket()
                return
        }

        // Store the connection globally
        upstreamConn = conn

        defer func() {
                conn.Close()
                upstreamConn = nil
                // Reconnect after a brief delay
                time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
                go connectToUpstreamWebSocket()
        }()

        log.Printf("Connected to upstream WebSocket")

        // Set up ping handler to keep connection alive
        conn.SetPingHandler(func(data string) error {
                err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.PongMessage, []byte{})
                if err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error sending pong: %v", err)
                        return err
                }
                return nil
        })

        // Re-subscribe to any existing instruments after reconnection
        resubscribeToInstruments()

        // Listen for messages from the upstream WebSocket
        for {
                _, message, err := conn.ReadMessage()
                if err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error reading from upstream WebSocket: %v", err)
                        return
                }

                // Process binary message from upstream server
                processMarketDataMessage(message)
        }
}

// subscribeToInstruments sends subscription requests to the upstream WebSocket
// Handles chunking of instruments in batches of 100 as per API limitation
func subscribeToInstruments(instruments []InstrumentInfo) bool {
        if upstreamConn == nil {
                log.Println("Cannot subscribe - not connected to upstream WebSocket")
                return false
        }

        // Process instruments in chunks of 100
        for i := 0; i < len(instruments); i += 100 {
                end := i + 100
                if end > len(instruments) {
                        end = len(instruments)
                }

                chunk := instruments[i:end]

                // Create subscription request
                req := InstrumentRequest{
                        RequestCode:     RequestCodeSubscribe,
                        InstrumentCount: len(chunk),
                        InstrumentList:  chunk,
                }

                // Send subscription request
                if err := upstreamConn.WriteJSON(req); err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error subscribing to instruments: %v", err)
                        return false
                }

                // Store subscribed instruments in the map for reconnection management
                for _, inst := range chunk {
                        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", inst.ExchangeSegment, inst.SecurityId)
                        subscribedInstruments[key] = true
                }

                log.Printf("Subscribed to %d instruments", len(chunk))
        }

        return true
}

// unsubscribeFromInstruments sends unsubscribe requests to the upstream WebSocket
func unsubscribeFromInstruments(instruments []InstrumentInfo) bool {
        if upstreamConn == nil {
                return false
        }

        // Process instruments in chunks of 100
        for i := 0; i < len(instruments); i += 100 {
                end := i + 100
                if end > len(instruments) {
                        end = len(instruments)
                }

                chunk := instruments[i:end]

                // Create unsubscription request
                req := InstrumentRequest{
                        RequestCode:     RequestCodeUnsubscribe,
                        InstrumentCount: len(chunk),
                        InstrumentList:  chunk,
                }

                // Send unsubscription request
                if err := upstreamConn.WriteJSON(req); err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error unsubscribing from instruments: %v", err)
                        return false
                }

                // Remove from the subscribed instruments map
                for _, inst := range chunk {
                        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", inst.ExchangeSegment, inst.SecurityId)
                        delete(subscribedInstruments, key)
                }

                log.Printf("Unsubscribed from %d instruments", len(chunk))
        }

        return true
}

// resubscribeToInstruments resubscribes to all previously subscribed instruments
// Called after reconnection to upstream WebSocket
func resubscribeToInstruments() {
        if len(subscribedInstruments) == 0 {
                return
        }

        instruments := []InstrumentInfo{}

        // Convert map keys back to InstrumentInfo objects
        for key := range subscribedInstruments {
                var segment, securityId string
                fmt.Sscanf(key, "%s:%s", &segment, &securityId)

                instruments = append(instruments, InstrumentInfo{
                        ExchangeSegment: segment,
                        SecurityId:      securityId,
                })
        }

        // Resubscribe to all instruments
        subscribeToInstruments(instruments)
}

// processMarketDataMessage handles different types of market data messages
func processMarketDataMessage(message []byte) {
        // Ensure we have at least header size data (8 bytes)
        if len(message) < 8 {
                log.Printf("Received invalid message: too short")
                return
        }

        // Parse message header
        feedCode := message[0]
        // messageLength := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(message[1:3])
        exchangeSegment := message[3]
        securityID := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(message[4:8])

        log.Printf("Received market data - Code: %d, Exchange: %d, SecurityID: %d",
                feedCode, exchangeSegment, securityID)

        // Process message based on feed code
        switch feedCode {
        case FeedCodeTicker:
                processTicker(message)
        case FeedCodeQuote:
                processQuote(message)
        case FeedCodeOI:
                processOpenInterest(message)
        case FeedCodePrevClose:
                processPrevClose(message)
        case FeedCodeFull:
                processFullPacket(message)
        case FeedCodeDisconnect:
                processDisconnection(message)
        default:
                // Unknown feed code
                log.Printf("Received unknown feed code: %d", feedCode)
        }

        // Broadcast the message to all connected clients
        broadcastMessage(message)
}

// processTicker handles ticker packet data
func processTicker(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 16 {
                return
        }

        // Extract data from ticker packet
        ltp := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12]))
        ltt := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[12:16])

        log.Printf("Ticker: LTP: %.2f, LTT: %d", ltp, ltt)

        // Extract header information
        exchangeSegment := data[3]
        securityID := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:8])

        // For ticker data, we don't have open/high/low values, so use LTP for all
        // Get symbol from the map of subscribed instruments
        var symbol string
        for key := range subscribedInstruments {
                var segment string
                var id string
                fmt.Sscanf(key, "%s:%s", &segment, &id)
                if id == fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID) {
                        symbol = id // Use ID as symbol if we don't have a better identifier
                        break
                }
        }

        // If symbol is empty, use security ID as the symbol
        if symbol == "" {
                symbol = fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID)
        }

        // Store in ClickHouse - use LTP for all OHLC values since this is a ticker update
        storeInstrumentData(securityID, exchangeSegment, symbol, ltp, ltt, 0.0, ltp, ltp, ltp, ltp)
}

// processQuote handles quote packet data
func processQuote(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 50 {
                return
        }

        // Extract basic quote data
        ltp := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12]))
        ltq := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12:14])
        ltt := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[14:18])
        atp := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[18:22]))
        volume := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[22:26])
        // Additional market data fields (logging only)
        // sellQty := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[26:30])
        // buyQty := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[30:34])

        // Extract OHLC data if available (indexes based on documentation)
        var open, high, low, close float32
        if len(data) >= 50 {
                open = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[34:38]))
                if len(data) >= 54 {
                        close = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[38:42]))
                }
                if len(data) >= 46 {
                        high = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[42:46]))
                }
                if len(data) >= 50 {
                        low = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[46:50]))
                }
        }

        // If any value is 0, use ltp as fallback
        if open == 0 {
                open = ltp
        }
        if high == 0 {
                high = ltp
        }
        if low == 0 {
                low = ltp
        }
        if close == 0 {
                close = ltp
        }

        log.Printf("Quote: LTP: %.2f, LTQ: %d, LTT: %d, ATP: %.2f, Vol: %d, O: %.2f, H: %.2f, L: %.2f, C: %.2f",
                ltp, ltq, ltt, atp, volume, open, high, low, close)

        // Extract header information
        exchangeSegment := data[3]
        securityID := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:8])

        // Get symbol from the map of subscribed instruments
        var symbol string
        for key := range subscribedInstruments {
                var segment string
                var id string
                fmt.Sscanf(key, "%s:%s", &segment, &id)
                if id == fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID) {
                        symbol = id // Use ID as symbol if we don't have a better identifier
                        break
                }
        }

        // If symbol is empty, use security ID as the symbol
        if symbol == "" {
                symbol = fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID)
        }

        // Store complete OHLCV data in ClickHouse
        storeInstrumentData(securityID, exchangeSegment, symbol, ltp, ltt, float64(volume), open, high, low, close)
}

// processOpenInterest handles OI packet data
func processOpenInterest(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 12 {
                return
        }

        // Extract OI data
        oi := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12])

        log.Printf("OI: %d", oi)
}

// processPrevClose handles previous day close packet data
func processPrevClose(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 16 {
                return
        }

        // Extract prev close data
        prevClose := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12]))
        prevOI := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[12:16])

        log.Printf("Prev Close: %.2f, Prev OI: %d", prevClose, prevOI)
}

// processFullPacket handles full market data packet
func processFullPacket(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 63 {
                return
        }

        // Extract key data from full packet
        ltp := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:12]))
        ltq := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12:14])
        ltt := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[14:18])
        atp := math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[18:22]))
        volume := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[22:26])

        // Extract OHLC data
        var open, high, low, close float32
        if len(data) >= 63 {
                open = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[46:50]))
                close = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[50:54]))
                high = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[54:58]))
                low = math.Float32frombits(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[58:62]))
        }

        // If any value is 0, use ltp as fallback
        if open == 0 {
                open = ltp
        }
        if high == 0 {
                high = ltp
        }
        if low == 0 {
                low = ltp
        }
        if close == 0 {
                close = ltp
        }

        log.Printf("Full Packet: LTP: %.2f, LTQ: %d, LTT: %d, ATP: %.2f, Vol: %d, O: %.2f, H: %.2f, L: %.2f, C: %.2f",
                ltp, ltq, ltt, atp, volume, open, high, low, close)

        // Extract header information
        exchangeSegment := data[3]
        securityID := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:8])

        // Get symbol from the map of subscribed instruments
        var symbol string
        for key := range subscribedInstruments {
                var segment string
                var id string
                fmt.Sscanf(key, "%s:%s", &segment, &id)
                if id == fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID) {
                        symbol = id // Use ID as symbol if we don't have a better identifier
                        break
                }
        }

        // If symbol is empty, use security ID as the symbol
        if symbol == "" {
                symbol = fmt.Sprintf("%d", securityID)
        }

        // Store complete OHLCV data in ClickHouse
        storeInstrumentData(securityID, exchangeSegment, symbol, ltp, ltt, float64(volume), open, high, low, close)
}

// processDisconnection handles disconnection messages
func processDisconnection(data []byte) {
        if len(data) < 10 {
                return
        }

        // Extract disconnection code
        disconnectCode := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[8:10])

        log.Printf("Disconnection received with code: %d", disconnectCode)
}

// broadcastMessage sends a message to all connected clients
func broadcastMessage(message []byte) {
        clientsMutex.Lock()
        defer clientsMutex.Unlock()

        for client := range clients {
                err := client.WriteMessage(websocket.BinaryMessage, message)
                if err != nil {
                        log.Printf("Error broadcasting to client: %v", err)
                        client.Close()
                        delete(clients, client)
                }
        }
}

// getEnv gets environment variable or returns default value
func getEnv(key, defaultValue string) string {
        value := os.Getenv(key)
        if value == "" {
                return defaultValue
        }
        return value
}

// storeInstrumentData stores market data in ClickHouse
func storeInstrumentData(securityID uint32, exchangeSegment byte, symbol string, price float32, timestamp uint32, volume float64, open, high, low, close float32) {
        // Skip if ClickHouse is not connected
        if chDB == nil || instrumentRepository == nil {
                log.Println("Skipping data storage: database not connected")
                return
        }

        // Convert timestamp from Unix to time.Time
        timestampTime := time.Unix(int64(timestamp), 0)

        // Create instrument model
        instrument := &model.Instrument{
                ExchangeSecurityID: int32(securityID),
                Open:               float64(open),
                High:               float64(high),
                Low:                float64(low),
                Close:              float64(close),
                Volume:             volume,
                Timestamp:          timestampTime,
                CreatedAt:          time.Now(),
                UpdatedAt:          time.Now(),
        }

        // Store in ClickHouse
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
        defer cancel()

        if err := instrumentRepository.Create(ctx, instrument); err != nil {
                log.Printf("Error storing instrument data: %v", err)
                return
        }

        log.Printf("Stored ticker data for %s (ExchangeSecurityID: %d) at %s",
                symbol, securityID, timestampTime.Format(time.RFC3339))
}

package main

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "log"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/signal"
        "syscall"
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/backtest"
        "algo/internal/modules/community"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument"
        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace"
        "algo/internal/modules/oauth"
        "algo/internal/modules/strategy"
        "algo/internal/modules/user"

        "github.com/gin-contrib/cors"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "github.com/joho/godotenv"
)

func main() {
        // Load environment variables
        if err := godotenv.Load(); err != nil {
                log.Println("Warning: .env file not found")
        }

        // Set Gin mode
        gin.SetMode(getEnv("GIN_MODE", "debug"))

        // Initialize router
        router := gin.Default()

        // Setup CORS
        setupCORS(router)

        // Setup middleware
        setupMiddleware(router)

        // Setup API routes
        apiRouter := router.Group("/api")

        // Initialize modules
        initializeModules(apiRouter)

        // Get port from environment or use default
        port := getEnv("PORT", "9090")
        serverAddr := fmt.Sprintf(":%s", port)

        // Create a server with graceful shutdown
        server := &http.Server{
                Addr:    serverAddr,
                Handler: router,
        }

        // Start the server in a goroutine
        go func() {
                log.Printf("Server started on port %s", port)
                if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
                        log.Fatalf("Server error: %s", err)
                }
        }()

        // Wait for interrupt signal to gracefully shut down the server
        quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
        signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
        <-quit

        log.Println("Shutting down server...")

        // Create a deadline for server shutdown
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
        defer cancel()

        // Shut down the server
        if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
                log.Fatal("Server forced to shutdown:", err)
        }

        log.Println("Server exited properly")
}

// setupCORS configures CORS middleware
func setupCORS(router *gin.Engine) {
        router.Use(cors.New(cors.Config{
                AllowOrigins:     []string{"*"},
                AllowMethods:     []string{"GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"},
                AllowHeaders:     []string{"Origin", "Authorization", "Content-Type"},
                ExposeHeaders:    []string{"Content-Length"},
                AllowCredentials: true,
                MaxAge:           12 * time.Hour,
        }))
}

// setupMiddleware adds global middleware to the router
func setupMiddleware(router *gin.Engine) {
        // Add request ID middleware
        router.Use(requestIDMiddleware())

        // Add logging middleware
        router.Use(loggingMiddleware())

        // Add recovery middleware (already included in gin.Default())
}

// requestIDMiddleware generates a unique request ID for each request
func requestIDMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                c.Writer.Header().Set("X-Request-ID", generateRequestID())
                c.Next()
        }
}

// generateRequestID creates a unique ID for request tracing
func generateRequestID() string {
        // Simple implementation - in production, use a more robust method
        return fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// loggingMiddleware logs request information
func loggingMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Start timer
                start := time.Now()

                // Process request
                c.Next()

                // Log request details
                latency := time.Since(start)
                log.Printf(
                        "[%s] %s %s %d %s",
                        c.Request.Method,
                        c.Request.URL.Path,
                        c.ClientIP(),
                        c.Writer.Status(),
                        latency,
                )
        }
}

// initializeModules initializes and connects all application modules
func initializeModules(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Initialize user module first as other modules depend on its controllers for auth
        userModule := user.New()
        userModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Get the user controller to pass to other modules for auth
        userController := userModule.GetController()

        // Initialize instrument module
        instrumentModule := instrument.New()
        instrumentModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Initialize strategy module
        strategyModule := strategy.New()
        // Set user controller to enable auth middleware for all strategy endpoints
        // This ensures that all strategy endpoints are protected by authentication
        strategyModule.SetUserController(userController)
        strategyModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Initialize backtest module
        backtestModule := backtest.New()
        backtestModule.SetUserController(userController)
        backtestModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Initialize marketplace module
        marketplaceModule := marketplace.New()
        marketplaceModule.SetUserController(userController)
        marketplaceModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Initialize community module
        communityModule := community.New()
        communityModule.SetUserController(userController)
        communityModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Initialize oauth module
        oauthModule := oauth.New()
        oauthModule.Initialize(userController)
        oauthModule.RegisterRoutes(router)

        // Additional modules will be initialized here
}

// getEnv gets environment variable or returns default value
func getEnv(key, defaultValue string) string {
        value := os.Getenv(key)
        if value == "" {
                return defaultValue
        }
        return value
}

package main

import (
        "encoding/csv"
        "fmt"
        "math/rand"
        "os"
        "time"
)

var file = "sql/ohlcv_data.csv"
var count = 1_000_000

func main() {
        // Generate and print OHLCV data to CSV
        if err := generateOHLCVDataToCSV(file, count, 1678886400, 1778886400); err != nil {
                panic(err)
        }

        fmt.Println("OHLCV data generated and saved to ohlcv_data.csv")
}

func generateOHLCVDataToCSV(filename string, count int, startTime int64, endTime int64) error {
        file, err := os.Create(filename)
        if err != nil {
                return err
        }
        defer file.Close()

        writer := csv.NewWriter(file)
        defer writer.Flush()

        // Write header
        if err := writer.Write([]string{"timestamp", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "created_at", "updated_at"}); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        currentTime := startTime
        for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
                open := rand.Float64() * 1000
                high := open + rand.Float64()*10
                low := open - rand.Float64()*10
                close := low + rand.Float64()*(high-low)
                volume := uint64(rand.Intn(1000000)) // Generate random volume as UInt64

                // Format timestamps without time zone information
                timestamp := time.Unix(currentTime, 0).UTC().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
                now := time.Now().UTC().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")

                record := []string{
                        timestamp,
                        fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", open),
                        fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", high),
                        fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", low),
                        fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", close),
                        fmt.Sprintf("%d", volume),
                        now,
                        now,
                }

                if err := writer.Write(record); err != nil {
                        return err
                }

                currentTime += 60
                if currentTime > endTime {
                        currentTime = startTime
                }
        }

        return nil
}

package entity

import (
        "time"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
        "golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

// User represents a user entity in the system
type User struct {
        ID          uuid.UUID `json:"id" db:"id"`
        Name        string    `json:"name" db:"name"`
        Username    string    `json:"username" db:"username"`
        Email       string    `json:"email" db:"email"`
        PhoneNumber string    `json:"phone_number" db:"phone_number"`
        Password    string    `json:"-" db:"password"` // Never expose password in JSON
        Verified    bool      `json:"verified" db:"verified"`
        CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at" db:"created_at"`
        UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at" db:"updated_at"`
        IsActive    bool      `json:"is_active" db:"is_active"`
        Roles       []Role    `json:"roles,omitempty" db:"-"` // Roles are loaded separately
}

// Role represents a role entity in the system
type Role struct {
        ID          int       `json:"id" db:"id"`
        Name        RoleType  `json:"name" db:"name"`
        Description string    `json:"description" db:"description"`
        CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at" db:"created_at"`
        UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at" db:"updated_at"`
}

// RoleType is an enum representing the possible role types
type RoleType string

// Role type constants
const (
        RoleAdmin     RoleType = "admin"
        RolePaidUser  RoleType = "paid_user"
        RoleFreeUser  RoleType = "free_user"
        RoleModerator RoleType = "moderator"
        RoleAnalyst   RoleType = "analyst"
)

// Permission represents a permission entity in the system
type Permission struct {
        ID           int            `json:"id" db:"id"`
        Name         PermissionType `json:"name" db:"name"`
        Description  string         `json:"description" db:"description"`
        ResourceType string         `json:"resource_type" db:"resource_type"`
        Action       string         `json:"action" db:"action"`
        CreatedAt    time.Time      `json:"created_at" db:"created_at"`
}

// PermissionType is an enum representing the possible permission types
type PermissionType string

// Permission type constants
const (
        // Strategy permissions
        PermCreateStrategy    PermissionType = "create_strategy"
        PermViewAnyStrategy   PermissionType = "view_any_strategy"
        PermEditOwnStrategy   PermissionType = "edit_own_strategy"
        PermDeleteOwnStrategy PermissionType = "delete_own_strategy"

        // Backtest permissions
        PermRunBacktest     PermissionType = "run_backtest"
        PermViewOwnBacktest PermissionType = "view_own_backtest"
        PermViewAnyBacktest PermissionType = "view_any_backtest"

        // Marketplace permissions
        PermPublishStrategy  PermissionType = "publish_strategy"
        PermPurchaseStrategy PermissionType = "purchase_strategy"

        // Paper trading
        PermRunPaperTrade PermissionType = "run_paper_trade"

        // Live trading
        PermRunLiveTrade PermissionType = "run_live_trade"

        // Community permissions
        PermCreateTopic     PermissionType = "create_topic"
        PermModerateContent PermissionType = "moderate_content"
)

// NewUser creates a new user with default values
func NewUser(name, username, email, phoneNumber, password string) (*User, error) {
        // Hash password before storing
        hashedPassword, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        now := time.Now()
        return &User{
                ID:          uuid.New(),
                Name:        name,
                Username:    username,
                Email:       email,
                PhoneNumber: phoneNumber,
                Password:    string(hashedPassword),
                Verified:    false,
                CreatedAt:   now,
                UpdatedAt:   now,
                IsActive:    true,
        }, nil
}

// ComparePassword compares the provided password with the stored hash
func (u *User) ComparePassword(password string) error {
        return bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(u.Password), []byte(password))
}

// UpdatePassword updates the user's password
func (u *User) UpdatePassword(password string) error {
        hashedPassword, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
        if err != nil {
                return err
        }
        u.Password = string(hashedPassword)
        u.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
        return nil
}

// HasRole checks if the user has a specific role
func (u *User) HasRole(roleName RoleType) bool {
        for _, role := range u.Roles {
                if role.Name == roleName {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// SetVerified marks the user as verified
func (u *User) SetVerified() {
        u.Verified = true
        u.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
}

// Deactivate deactivates the user account
func (u *User) Deactivate() {
        u.IsActive = false
        u.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
}

// Activate activates the user account
func (u *User) Activate() {
        u.IsActive = true
        u.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
}

package middleware

import (
        "net/http"

        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// AuthService defines the interface for authentication service
// This allows us to decouple the middleware from the specific auth implementation
type AuthService interface {
        ValidateToken(ctx interface{}, tokenString string) (interface{}, error)
        GetUserIDFromToken(tokenString string) (interface{}, error)
        HasRole(tokenString string, role string) (bool, error)
}

// ExtractToken extracts the JWT token from the request
// Looks for token in Authorization header (Bearer token) or in cookie
func ExtractToken(ctx *gin.Context) string {
        // First, try to get token from Authorization header
        // bearerToken := ctx.GetHeader("Authorization")
        // if len(bearerToken) > 7 && strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(bearerToken), "BEARER ") {
        //         return bearerToken[7:]
        // }

        // If not in header, try to get from cookie
        cookie, err := ctx.Request.Cookie("token")
        if err == nil && cookie.Value != "" {
                return cookie.Value
        }

        return ""
}

// AuthMiddleware implements authentication middleware
// This middleware validates the JWT token and sets the userID in the context
// It can be reused across different modules to ensure authentication
func AuthMiddleware(authService AuthService) gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(ctx *gin.Context) {
                // Get the token from header or cookie
                tokenString := ExtractToken(ctx)
                if tokenString == "" {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "No token provided",
                        })
                        return
                }

                // Validate the token - pass the request context
                claims, err := authService.ValidateToken(ctx.Request.Context(), tokenString)
                if err != nil {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "Invalid token: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        return
                }

                // Set user ID in context for other handlers
                userID, err := authService.GetUserIDFromToken(tokenString)
                if err != nil {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "Invalid token: user ID extraction failed",
                        })
                        return
                }

                // Set userID in context for use in handler functions
                ctx.Set("userID", userID)
                ctx.Set("claims", claims)
                ctx.Set("token", tokenString) // Add the token to context for use by other handlers if needed

                ctx.Next()
        }
}

// AdminMiddleware implements admin role middleware
// This middleware checks if the user has the admin role
func AdminMiddleware(authService AuthService) gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(ctx *gin.Context) {
                // Get the token from header or cookie
                tokenString := ExtractToken(ctx)
                if tokenString == "" {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "No token provided",
                        })
                        return
                }

                // Check if user has admin role
                hasAdminRole, err := authService.HasRole(tokenString, "admin")
                if err != nil {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "Invalid token: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        return
                }

                if !hasAdminRole {
                        ctx.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{
                                "success": false,
                                "error":   "Permission denied: Admin role required",
                        })
                        return
                }

                ctx.Next()
        }
}

package repository

import (
        "os"
        "sync"

        _ "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
        "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)

// Global variable to store the ClickHouse DB connection
var (
        clickHouseDB *sqlx.DB
        clickHouseMu sync.Mutex
)

// ProvideClickHouseDB provides a ClickHouse database connection
func ProvideClickHouseDB() (*sqlx.DB, error) {
        clickHouseMu.Lock()
        defer clickHouseMu.Unlock()

        // Return existing connection if available
        if clickHouseDB != nil {
                return clickHouseDB, nil
        }

        conn := os.Getenv("CH_URL")
        if conn == "" {
                conn = "clickhouse://admin:admin@localhost:9000"
        }

        db, err := sqlx.Connect("clickhouse", conn)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Save the connection to the global variable
        clickHouseDB = db
        return clickHouseDB, nil
}

package repository

import (
        "database/sql"
        "os"
        "sync"

        _ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// Global variable to store the PostgreSQL DB connection
var (
        postgresDB *sql.DB
        postgresMu sync.Mutex
)

// ProvidePostgresDB provides a PostgreSQL database connection
func ProvidePostgresDB() (*sql.DB, error) {
        postgresMu.Lock()
        defer postgresMu.Unlock()

        // Return existing connection if available
        if postgresDB != nil {
                return postgresDB, nil
        }

        connStr := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
        if connStr == "" {
                connStr = "postgresql://admin:admin@localhost:9009/sutram?sslmode=disable"
        }

        db, err := sql.Open("postgres", connStr)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Save the connection to the global variable
        postgresDB = db
        return postgresDB, nil
}

package service

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/backtest/application/dto"
        "algo/internal/modules/backtest/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/backtest/domain/repository"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Common errors
var (
        ErrRunGroupNotFound     = errors.New("run group not found")
        ErrRunNotFound          = errors.New("run not found")
        ErrPositionNotFound     = errors.New("position not found")
        ErrRunMetricsNotFound   = errors.New("run metrics not found")
        ErrInvalidRequest       = errors.New("invalid request")
        ErrRunGroupCreateFailed = errors.New("failed to create run group")
        ErrRunCreateFailed      = errors.New("failed to create run")
        ErrPositionCreateFailed = errors.New("failed to create position")
        ErrMetricsCreateFailed  = errors.New("failed to create run metrics")
)

// BacktestService defines the service for backtest operations
type BacktestService interface {
        // Run Group operations
        CreateRunGroup(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunGroupRequest) (*dto.RunGroupDTO, error)
        GetRunGroup(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*dto.RunGroupDTO, error)
        GetRunGroupsByStrategy(ctx context.Context, strategyID uuid.UUID) ([]*dto.RunGroupDTO, error)
        DeleteRunGroup(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error

        // Run operations
        CreateRun(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunRequest) (*dto.RunDTO, error)
        GetRun(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*dto.RunDTO, error)
        GetRunsByRunGroup(ctx context.Context, runGroupID uuid.UUID) ([]*dto.RunDTO, error)
        GetRunsByStrategy(ctx context.Context, strategyID uuid.UUID) ([]*dto.RunDTO, error)
        UpdateRunState(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.UpdateRunStateRequest) (*dto.RunDTO, error)
        DeleteRun(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error
        SearchRuns(ctx context.Context, filter *dto.RunFilter) ([]*dto.RunDTO, error)

        // Position operations
        CreatePosition(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreatePositionRequest) (*dto.PositionDTO, error)
        GetPosition(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*dto.PositionDTO, error)
        GetPositionsByRun(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID) ([]*dto.PositionDTO, error)
        EnterPosition(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.EnterPositionRequest) (*dto.PositionDTO, error)
        ExitPosition(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.ExitPositionRequest) (*dto.PositionDTO, error)
        DeletePosition(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error

        // Run Metrics operations
        CreateRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunMetricsRequest) (*dto.RunMetricsDTO, error)
        GetRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID) (*dto.RunMetricsDTO, error)
        UpdateRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.CreateRunMetricsRequest) (*dto.RunMetricsDTO, error)
        DeleteRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error
}

// backtestService implements the BacktestService interface
type backtestService struct {
        runGroupRepo   repository.RunGroupRepository
        runRepo        repository.RunRepository
        positionRepo   repository.PositionRepository
        runMetricsRepo repository.RunMetricsRepository
}

// NewBacktestService creates a new backtest service
func NewBacktestService(
        runGroupRepo repository.RunGroupRepository,
        runRepo repository.RunRepository,
        positionRepo repository.PositionRepository,
        runMetricsRepo repository.RunMetricsRepository,
) BacktestService {
        return &backtestService{
                runGroupRepo:   runGroupRepo,
                runRepo:        runRepo,
                positionRepo:   positionRepo,
                runMetricsRepo: runMetricsRepo,
        }
}

// CreateRunGroup creates a new run group
func (s *backtestService) CreateRunGroup(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunGroupRequest) (*dto.RunGroupDTO, error) {
        // Create domain model
        runGroup := model.NewRunGroup(req.StrategyID)

        // Save to database
        if err := s.runGroupRepo.Create(ctx, runGroup); err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunGroupCreateFailed, err)
        }

        // Return DTO
        return &dto.RunGroupDTO{
                ID:         runGroup.ID,
                StrategyID: runGroup.StrategyID,
                CreatedAt:  runGroup.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:  runGroup.UpdatedAt,
        }, nil
}

// GetRunGroup retrieves a run group by ID
func (s *backtestService) GetRunGroup(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*dto.RunGroupDTO, error) {
        // Get from database
        runGroup, err := s.runGroupRepo.GetByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunGroupNotFound, err)
        }

        // Return DTO
        return &dto.RunGroupDTO{
                ID:         runGroup.ID,
                StrategyID: runGroup.StrategyID,
                CreatedAt:  runGroup.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:  runGroup.UpdatedAt,
        }, nil
}

// GetRunGroupsByStrategy retrieves all run groups for a specific strategy
func (s *backtestService) GetRunGroupsByStrategy(ctx context.Context, strategyID uuid.UUID) ([]*dto.RunGroupDTO, error) {
        // Get from database
        runGroups, err := s.runGroupRepo.GetByStrategyID(ctx, strategyID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunGroupNotFound, err)
        }

        // Convert to DTOs
        result := make([]*dto.RunGroupDTO, 0, len(runGroups))
        for _, runGroup := range runGroups {
                result = append(result, &dto.RunGroupDTO{
                        ID:         runGroup.ID,
                        StrategyID: runGroup.StrategyID,
                        CreatedAt:  runGroup.CreatedAt,
                        UpdatedAt:  runGroup.UpdatedAt,
                })
        }

        return result, nil
}

// DeleteRunGroup deletes a run group
func (s *backtestService) DeleteRunGroup(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error {
        // Delete from database
        if err := s.runGroupRepo.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
                return errors.Join(ErrRunGroupNotFound, err)
        }

        return nil
}

// CreateRun creates a new run
func (s *backtestService) CreateRun(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunRequest) (*dto.RunDTO, error) {
        // Create domain model
        run := model.NewRun(
                req.RunGroupID,
                req.StrategyID,
                req.Exchange,
                req.InstrumentID,
                model.RunType(req.Type),
                req.Qty,
                req.PeriodStartTime,
                req.PeriodEndTime,
        )

        // Save to database
        if err := s.runRepo.Create(ctx, run); err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunCreateFailed, err)
        }

        // Return DTO
        return &dto.RunDTO{
                ID:              run.ID,
                RunGroupID:      run.RunGroupID,
                StrategyID:      run.StrategyID,
                Exchange:        run.Exchange,
                InstrumentID:    run.InstrumentID,
                Type:            dto.RunType(run.Type),
                State:           dto.RunState(run.State),
                Qty:             run.Qty,
                PeriodStartTime: run.PeriodStartTime,
                PeriodEndTime:   run.PeriodEndTime,
                CreatedAt:       run.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:       run.UpdatedAt,
        }, nil

// UpdateRunState updates the state of a run
func (s *backtestService) UpdateRunState(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.UpdateRunStateRequest) (*dto.RunDTO, error) {
        // Get run
        run, err := s.runRepo.GetByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunNotFound, err)
        }

        // Update state
        run.State = model.RunState(req.State)
        run.UpdatedAt = time.Now()

        // Update started/ended times based on state
        now := time.Now()
        switch run.State {
        case model.Started:
                run.StartedTime = &now
        case model.Ended:
                run.EndedTime = &now
        }

        // Save to database
        if err := s.runRepo.Update(ctx, run); err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Convert nullable time fields
        var startedTime, endedTime time.Time
        if run.StartedTime != nil {
                startedTime = *run.StartedTime
        }
        if run.EndedTime != nil {
                endedTime = *run.EndedTime
        }

        // Return updated run
        return &dto.RunDTO{
                ID:              run.ID,
                RunGroupID:      run.RunGroupID,
                StrategyID:      run.StrategyID,
                Exchange:        run.Exchange,
                InstrumentID:    run.InstrumentID,
                Type:            dto.RunType(run.Type),
                State:           dto.RunState(run.State),
                Qty:             run.Qty,
                PeriodStartTime: run.PeriodStartTime,
                PeriodEndTime:   run.PeriodEndTime,
                StartedTime:     startedTime,
                EndedTime:       endedTime,
                CreatedAt:       run.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:       run.UpdatedAt,
        }, nil
}

// DeleteRun deletes a run
func (s *backtestService) DeleteRun(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error {
        // Delete from database
        if err := s.runRepo.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
                return errors.Join(ErrRunNotFound, err)
        }

        return nil
}

// SearchRuns searches runs with filter criteria
func (s *backtestService) SearchRuns(ctx context.Context, filter *dto.RunFilter) ([]*dto.RunDTO, error) {
        // Convert DTO filter to map for repository
        filters := make(map[string]interface{})

        if filter.StrategyID != nil {
                filters["strategy_id"] = *filter.StrategyID
        }

        if filter.Type != nil {
                filters["type"] = *filter.Type
        }

        if filter.State != nil {
                filters["state"] = *filter.State
        }

        if filter.Exchange != nil {
                filters["exchange"] = *filter.Exchange
        }

        if filter.InstrumentID != nil {
                filters["instrument_id"] = *filter.InstrumentID
        }

        // Search in database
        runs, err := s.runRepo.SearchRuns(ctx, filters)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Convert to DTOs
        result := make([]*dto.RunDTO, 0, len(runs))
        for _, run := range runs {
                // Create base DTO
                runDTO := &dto.RunDTO{
                        ID:              run.ID,
                        RunGroupID:      run.RunGroupID,
                        StrategyID:      run.StrategyID,
                        Exchange:        run.Exchange,
                        InstrumentID:    run.InstrumentID,
                        Type:            dto.RunType(run.Type),
                        State:           dto.RunState(run.State),
                        Qty:             run.Qty,
                        PeriodStartTime: run.PeriodStartTime,
                        PeriodEndTime:   run.PeriodEndTime,
                        CreatedAt:       run.CreatedAt,
                        UpdatedAt:       run.UpdatedAt,
                }

                // Handle nullable time fields
                if run.StartedTime != nil {
                        runDTO.StartedTime = *run.StartedTime
                }

                if run.EndedTime != nil {
                        runDTO.EndedTime = *run.EndedTime
                }

                result = append(result, runDTO)
        }

        return result, nil
}

// CreatePosition creates a new position
func (s *backtestService) CreatePosition(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreatePositionRequest) (*dto.PositionDTO, error) {

                req.RunID,
                model.Direction(req.Direction),
                req.EntryPriceSignal,
                req.EntryTimeSignal,
                req.EntrySignal,
                req.PositionSize,
        )

        // Save to database
        if err := s.positionRepo.Create(ctx, position); err != nil {

// CreateRunMetrics creates new run metrics
func (s *backtestService) CreateRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, req *dto.CreateRunMetricsRequest) (*dto.RunMetricsDTO, error) {
        // Create domain model
        metrics := model.NewRunMetrics(req.RunID)

        // Set non-pointer values
        metrics.TotalReturnPct = req.TotalReturnPct
        metrics.AnnualizedReturn = req.AnnualizedReturn
        metrics.DailyReturns = req.DailyReturns
        metrics.MonthlyReturns = req.MonthlyReturns
        metrics.SharpeRatio = req.SharpeRatio
        metrics.SortinoRatio = req.SortinoRatio
        metrics.MaxDrawdown = req.MaxDrawdown
        metrics.MaxDrawdownDuration = req.MaxDrawdownDuration
        metrics.StdDeviation = req.StdDeviation
        metrics.TotalTrades = req.TotalTrades
        metrics.WinRate = req.WinRate
        metrics.TotalCommission = req.TotalCommission
        metrics.TotalSlippage = req.TotalSlippage
        metrics.TransactionCostsPct = req.TransactionCostsPct
        metrics.MetricJSON = req.MetricJSON

        // Set pointer values
        valueAtRisk := req.ValueAtRisk
        metrics.ValueAtRisk = &valueAtRisk

        avgWinSize := req.AvgWinSize
        metrics.AvgWinSize = &avgWinSize

        avgLossSize := req.AvgLossSize
        metrics.AvgLossSize = &avgLossSize

        avgTradeDuration := req.AvgTradeDuration
        metrics.AvgTradeDuration = &avgTradeDuration

        profitFactor := req.ProfitFactor
        metrics.ProfitFactor = &profitFactor

        avgPositionSize := req.AvgPositionSize
        metrics.AvgPositionSize = &avgPositionSize

        maxPositionSize := req.MaxPositionSize
        metrics.MaxPositionSize = &maxPositionSize

        positionTurnover := req.PositionTurnover
        metrics.PositionTurnover = &positionTurnover

        avgExposure := req.AvgExposure
        metrics.AvgExposure = &avgExposure

        // Save to database
        if err := s.runMetricsRepo.Create(ctx, metrics); err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrMetricsCreateFailed, err)
        }

        // Return DTO
        return s.runMetricsToDTO(metrics), nil
}

        if err != nil {

// UpdateRunMetrics updates existing run metrics
func (s *backtestService) UpdateRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, req *dto.CreateRunMetricsRequest) (*dto.RunMetricsDTO, error) {
        // Get metrics
        metrics, err := s.runMetricsRepo.GetByRunID(ctx, req.RunID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, errors.Join(ErrRunMetricsNotFound, err)
        }

        // Ensure we're updating the correct metrics
        if metrics.ID != id {
                return nil, ErrRunMetricsNotFound
        }

        // Update non-pointer values
        metrics.TotalReturnPct = req.TotalReturnPct
        metrics.AnnualizedReturn = req.AnnualizedReturn
        metrics.DailyReturns = req.DailyReturns
        metrics.MonthlyReturns = req.MonthlyReturns
        metrics.SharpeRatio = req.SharpeRatio
        metrics.SortinoRatio = req.SortinoRatio
        metrics.MaxDrawdown = req.MaxDrawdown
        metrics.MaxDrawdownDuration = req.MaxDrawdownDuration
        metrics.StdDeviation = req.StdDeviation
        metrics.TotalTrades = req.TotalTrades
        metrics.WinRate = req.WinRate
        metrics.TotalCommission = req.TotalCommission
        metrics.TotalSlippage = req.TotalSlippage
        metrics.TransactionCostsPct = req.TransactionCostsPct
        metrics.MetricJSON = req.MetricJSON
        metrics.UpdatedAt = time.Now()

        // Update pointer values
        valueAtRisk := req.ValueAtRisk
        metrics.ValueAtRisk = &valueAtRisk

        avgWinSize := req.AvgWinSize
        metrics.AvgWinSize = &avgWinSize

        avgLossSize := req.AvgLossSize
        metrics.AvgLossSize = &avgLossSize

        avgTradeDuration := req.AvgTradeDuration
        metrics.AvgTradeDuration = &avgTradeDuration

        profitFactor := req.ProfitFactor
        metrics.ProfitFactor = &profitFactor

        avgPositionSize := req.AvgPositionSize
        metrics.AvgPositionSize = &avgPositionSize

        maxPositionSize := req.MaxPositionSize
        metrics.MaxPositionSize = &maxPositionSize

        positionTurnover := req.PositionTurnover
        metrics.PositionTurnover = &positionTurnover

        avgExposure := req.AvgExposure
        metrics.AvgExposure = &avgExposure

        // Save to database
        if err := s.runMetricsRepo.Update(ctx, metrics); err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Return updated metrics
        return s.runMetricsToDTO(metrics), nil
}

// DeleteRunMetrics deletes run metrics
func (s *backtestService) DeleteRunMetrics(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error {
        // Delete from database
        if err := s.runMetricsRepo.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
                return errors.Join(ErrRunMetricsNotFound, err)
        }

        return nil
}

// Helper method to convert position model to DTO
func (s *backtestService) positionToDTO(position *model.Position) *dto.PositionDTO {
        positionDTO := &dto.PositionDTO{
                ID:               position.ID,
                RunID:            position.RunID,
                State:            dto.PositionState(position.State),
                Direction:        dto.Direction(position.Direction),
                EntryPriceSignal: position.EntryPriceSignal,
                EntryTimeSignal:  position.EntryTimeSignal,
                EntrySignal:      position.EntrySignal,
                PositionSize:     position.PositionSize,
                EntryOrderID:     position.EntryOrderID,
                ExitOrderID:      position.ExitOrderID,
                CreatedAt:        position.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:        position.UpdatedAt,
        }

        // Handle nullable fields
        if position.EntryPriceOrder != nil {
                positionDTO.EntryPriceOrder = *position.EntryPriceOrder
        }

        if position.EntryTimeOrder != nil {
                positionDTO.EntryTimeOrder = *position.EntryTimeOrder
        }

        if position.ExitPriceSignal != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitPriceSignal = *position.ExitPriceSignal
        }

        if position.ExitTimeSignal != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitTimeSignal = *position.ExitTimeSignal
        }

        if position.ExitPriceOrder != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitPriceOrder = *position.ExitPriceOrder
        }

        if position.ExitTimeOrder != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitTimeOrder = *position.ExitTimeOrder
        }

        if position.ExitSignal != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitSignal = *position.ExitSignal
        }

        if position.ExitReason != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitReason = *position.ExitReason
        }

        if position.ProfitLossAbsolute != nil {
                positionDTO.ProfitLossAbsolute = *position.ProfitLossAbsolute
        }

        if position.ProfitLossPercentage != nil {
                positionDTO.ProfitLossPercentage = *position.ProfitLossPercentage
        }

        if position.TransactionCost != nil {
                positionDTO.TransactionCost = *position.TransactionCost
        }

        if position.EntryFees != nil {
                positionDTO.EntryFees = *position.EntryFees
        }

        if position.ExitFees != nil {
                positionDTO.ExitFees = *position.ExitFees
        }

        if position.NetProfitLoss != nil {
                positionDTO.NetProfitLoss = *position.NetProfitLoss
        }

        return positionDTO
}

// Helper method to convert run metrics model to DTO

        metricsDTO := &dto.RunMetricsDTO{

                StdDeviation:        metrics.StdDeviation,
                TotalTrades:         metrics.TotalTrades,
                WinRate:             metrics.WinRate,
                TotalCommission:     metrics.TotalCommission,
                TotalSlippage:       metrics.TotalSlippage,
                TransactionCostsPct: metrics.TransactionCostsPct,
                MetricJSON:          metrics.MetricJSON,
                CreatedAt:           metrics.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:           metrics.UpdatedAt,
        }

        // Handle nullable fields
        if metrics.RiskAdjustedReturn != nil {
