package community

import (
        "database/sql"

        infraRepo "algo/internal/infra/persistance/repository"
        "algo/internal/modules/community/application/service"
        "algo/internal/modules/community/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
        "algo/internal/modules/community/interfaces/http"
        userHttp "algo/internal/modules/user/interfaces/http"

        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "github.com/google/wire"
)

// Module represents the community module
type Module struct {
        db             *sql.DB
        controller     *http.CommunityController
        userController interface{}
}

// ProvideModule provides a wire provider set for the community module
var ProvideModule = wire.NewSet(
        ProvideCommunityModule,
)

// ProvideCommunityModule provides a community module instance
func ProvideCommunityModule() (*Module, error) {
        return New(), nil
}

// New creates a new community module
func New() *Module {
        // Get database connection
        db, err := infraRepo.ProvidePostgresDB()
        if err != nil {
                panic(err) // In a real app, handle this more gracefully
        }

        module := &Module{
                db: db,
        }

        // Initialize module components
        module.initialize()

        return module
}

// initialize sets up the community module
func (m *Module) initialize() {
        // Create repositories
        topicRepo := postgres.NewTopicRepository(m.db)
        categoryRepo := postgres.NewCategoryRepository(m.db)
        postRepo := postgres.NewPostRepository(m.db)
        tagRepo := postgres.NewTagRepository(m.db)
        userReputationRepo := postgres.NewUserReputationRepository(m.db)
        likeRepo := postgres.NewLikeRepository(m.db)
        bookmarkRepo := postgres.NewBookmarkRepository(m.db)
        pollRepo := postgres.NewPollRepository(m.db)
        badgeRepo := postgres.NewBadgeRepository(m.db)

        // Create services
        topicService := service.NewTopicService(topicRepo, tagRepo, categoryRepo)
        categoryService := service.NewCategoryService(categoryRepo)
        postService := service.NewPostService(postRepo, topicRepo)
        userService := service.NewUserService(userReputationRepo, badgeRepo)
        likeService := service.NewLikeService(likeRepo, topicRepo, postRepo)
        bookmarkService := service.NewBookmarkService(bookmarkRepo, topicRepo)
        pollService := service.NewPollService(pollRepo, topicRepo)
        badgeService := service.NewBadgeService(badgeRepo, userReputationRepo)

        // Create controller
        m.controller = http.NewCommunityController(
                topicService,
                categoryService,
                postService,
                userService,
                likeService,
                bookmarkService,
                pollService,
                badgeService,
        )
}

// RegisterRoutes registers the community module routes with the given router
func (m *Module) RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Cast userController to the expected type
        userController, ok := m.userController.(*userHttp.UserController)
        if !ok {
                // If userController is not set or is of wrong type, we can't proceed with auth
                // In a production app, you'd want to log this error properly
                panic("Community module: UserController not set or invalid type")
        }

        http.RegisterRoutes(router, m.controller, userController)
}

// GetController returns the community controller
func (m *Module) GetController() *http.CommunityController {
        return m.controller
}

// SetUserController sets the user controller for auth middleware
func (m *Module) SetUserController(userController interface{}) {
        m.userController = userController
}

package service

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/repository"
)

// Common errors
var (
        ErrInstrumentNotFound = errors.New("instrument not found")
        ErrInvalidTimeRange   = errors.New("invalid time range")
)

// InstrumentService handles instrument-related business logic
type InstrumentService struct {
        instrumentRepo       repository.InstrumentRepository
        instrumentMasterRepo repository.InstrumentMasterRepository
}

// NewInstrumentService creates a new instrument service
func NewInstrumentService(
        instrumentRepo repository.InstrumentRepository,
        instrumentMasterRepo repository.InstrumentMasterRepository,
) *InstrumentService {
        return &InstrumentService{
                instrumentRepo:       instrumentRepo,
                instrumentMasterRepo: instrumentMasterRepo,
        }
}

// GetInstrumentsByExchangeSecurityID gets instruments by exchange security ID
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentsByExchangeSecurityID(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32) ([]*model.Instrument, error) {
        instruments, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityID(ctx, exchangeSecurityID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instruments: %w", err)
        }
        if len(instruments) == 0 {
                return nil, ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }
        return instruments, nil
}

// GetInstrumentMasterByID gets an instrument master by ID
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentMasterByID(ctx context.Context, id uint64) (*model.InstrumentMaster, error) {
        instrumentMaster, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        if instrumentMaster == nil {
                return nil, ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }
        return instrumentMaster, nil
}

// GetInstrumentsByTimeRange gets instruments by exchange security ID within a time range
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentsByTimeRange(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32, start, end time.Time, timeFrame string) ([]*model.Instrument, error) {
        // Validate time range
        if start.After(end) {
                return nil, ErrInvalidTimeRange
        }

        // Default to '1m' if timeFrame is empty
        if timeFrame == "" {
                timeFrame = "1m"
        }

        instruments, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityIDAndTimeRange(ctx, exchangeSecurityID, start, end, timeFrame)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instruments by time range: %w", err)
        }
        return instruments, nil
}

// GetInstrumentMasterBySymbol gets an instrument master by symbol
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentMasterBySymbol(ctx context.Context, symbol string) (*model.InstrumentMaster, error) {
        instrumentMaster, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindBySymbol(ctx, symbol)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument master by symbol: %w", err)
        }
        if instrumentMaster == nil {
                return nil, ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }
        return instrumentMaster, nil
}

// GetAllInstrumentMasters gets all instrument masters
func (s *InstrumentService) GetAllInstrumentMasters(ctx context.Context) ([]*model.InstrumentMaster, error) {
        instrumentMasters, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindAll(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding all instrument masters: %w", err)
        }
        return instrumentMasters, nil
}

// GetInstrumentMastersWithFilters gets instrument masters with filtering and pagination
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentMastersWithFilters(ctx context.Context, exchange, segment string, page, pageSize int) ([]*model.InstrumentMaster, int, error) {
        if page < 1 {
                page = 1
        }
        if pageSize < 1 {
                pageSize = 10
        }

        offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
        limit := pageSize

        instrumentMasters, totalCount, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindWithFilters(ctx, exchange, segment, offset, limit)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument masters with filters: %w", err)
        }

        return instrumentMasters, totalCount, nil
}

// CreateInstrument creates a new instrument
func (s *InstrumentService) CreateInstrument(ctx context.Context, instrument *model.Instrument) error {
        now := time.Now()
        instrument.CreatedAt = now
        instrument.UpdatedAt = now

        if err := s.instrumentRepo.Create(ctx, instrument); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error creating instrument: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// UpdateInstrument updates an instrument
func (s *InstrumentService) UpdateInstrument(ctx context.Context, instrument *model.Instrument) error {
        // Check if instrument exists
        existingInstruments, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityID(ctx, instrument.ExchangeSecurityID)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument: %w", err)
        }
        if len(existingInstruments) == 0 {
                return ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }

        // Find the specific instrument with matching timestamp
        var existing *model.Instrument
        for _, inst := range existingInstruments {
                if inst.Timestamp.Equal(instrument.Timestamp) {
                        existing = inst
                        break
                }
        }

        if existing == nil {
                return ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }

        // Update timestamp
        instrument.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
        instrument.CreatedAt = existing.CreatedAt

        if err := s.instrumentRepo.Update(ctx, instrument); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error updating instrument: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// CreateInstrumentMaster creates a new instrument master
func (s *InstrumentService) CreateInstrumentMaster(ctx context.Context, master *model.InstrumentMaster) error {
        if err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.Create(ctx, master); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error creating instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// UpdateInstrumentMaster updates an instrument master
func (s *InstrumentService) UpdateInstrumentMaster(ctx context.Context, master *model.InstrumentMaster) error {
        // Check if instrument master exists
        existing, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindByID(ctx, master.ID)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        if existing == nil {
                return ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }

        if err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.Update(ctx, master); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error updating instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// DeleteInstrument deletes instruments by exchange security ID
func (s *InstrumentService) DeleteInstrument(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32) error {
        // Check if instruments exist
        existing, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityID(ctx, exchangeSecurityID)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error finding instruments: %w", err)
        }
        if len(existing) == 0 {
                return ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }

        if err := s.instrumentRepo.Delete(ctx, exchangeSecurityID); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error deleting instruments: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// DeleteInstrumentMaster deletes an instrument master
func (s *InstrumentService) DeleteInstrumentMaster(ctx context.Context, id uint64) error {
        // Check if instrument master exists
        existing, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        if existing == nil {
                return ErrInstrumentNotFound
        }

        if err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error deleting instrument master: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// GetInstrumentDataWithLookback gets instrument data for a given time range plus historical lookback data
// Combines both the requested date range data and lookback data into a single result
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentDataWithLookback(
        ctx context.Context,
        exchangeSecurityID int32,
        start, end time.Time,
        timeFrame string,
        lookBack int,
) (*model.StockData, error) {
        // Validate time range
        if start.After(end) {
                return nil, ErrInvalidTimeRange
        }

        // Get data for the requested date range
        rangeInstruments, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityIDAndTimeRange(ctx, exchangeSecurityID, start, end, timeFrame)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instruments for date range: %w", err)
        }

        // Convert pointers to values for StockData
        dateRangeData := make(model.StockData, len(rangeInstruments))
        for i, instrument := range rangeInstruments {
                dateRangeData[i] = *instrument
        }

        // Calculate lookback start time (this would depend on timeFrame implementation)
        // For now, we'll assume lookBack is in days
        lookBackStart := start.AddDate(0, 0, -lookBack)

        // Get lookback data
        lookBackInstruments, err := s.instrumentRepo.FindByExchangeSecurityIDAndTimeRange(ctx, exchangeSecurityID, lookBackStart, start, timeFrame)
        if err != nil {
                // If there's an error with lookback, just return the date range data
                return &dateRangeData, nil
        }

        // Convert pointers to values for StockData
        lookBackData := make(model.StockData, len(lookBackInstruments))
        for i, instrument := range lookBackInstruments {
                lookBackData[i] = *instrument
        }

        // Reverse the lookback data (older to newer)
        for i, j := 0, len(lookBackData)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
                lookBackData[i], lookBackData[j] = lookBackData[j], lookBackData[i]
        }

        // Combine lookback and date range data
        result := append(make(model.StockData, 0), lookBackData...)
        result = append(result, dateRangeData...)

        return &result, nil
}

// GetInstrumentMastersByIDs gets multiple instrument masters by their IDs
func (s *InstrumentService) GetInstrumentMastersByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []uint64) ([]*model.InstrumentMaster, error) {
        instrumentMasters, err := s.instrumentMasterRepo.FindByIDs(ctx, ids)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error finding instrument masters by IDs: %w", err)
        }
        return instrumentMasters, nil
}

package clickhouse

import (

        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"

// InstrumentMasterRepository is a ClickHouse implementation of the InstrumentMasterRepository interface
type InstrumentMasterRepository struct {

}

// NewInstrumentMasterRepository creates a new ClickHouse instrument master repository
func NewInstrumentMasterRepository(db *sqlx.DB) repository.InstrumentMasterRepository {
        return &InstrumentMasterRepository{
                db: db,
        }

                instrumentMaster.Exchange,

// Update updates an instrument master
func (r *InstrumentMasterRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, instrumentMaster *model.InstrumentMaster) error {
        // Note: ClickHouse typically doesn't support direct updates as in traditional RDBMS
        // This is a simplified version assuming you're using ALTER TABLE UPDATE syntax
        query := `
                ALTER TABLE instrument_master UPDATE
                        exchange = ?,
                        segment = ?,
                        symbol = ?,
                        instrument = ?,
                        start_date = ?,
                        expiry = ?
                WHERE id = ?
        `

        _, err := r.db.ExecContext(
                ctx,
                query,
                instrumentMaster.Exchange,
                instrumentMaster.Segment,
                instrumentMaster.Symbol,
                instrumentMaster.Name,
                instrumentMaster.StartDate,
                instrumentMaster.Expiry,
                instrumentMaster.ID,

// Delete deletes an instrument master
func (r *InstrumentMasterRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id uint64) error {
        query := `
                ALTER TABLE instrument_master DELETE WHERE id = ?
        `

        _, err := r.db.ExecContext(ctx, query, id)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error deleting instrument master: %w", err)
        }

        return nil
}

// FindWithFilters returns instrument masters with filtering and pagination
func (r *InstrumentMasterRepository) FindWithFilters(ctx context.Context, exchange, segment string, offset, limit int) ([]*model.InstrumentMaster, int, error) {
        // Build the WHERE clause based on filters
        var whereConditions []string
        var args []interface{}

        if exchange != "" {
                whereConditions = append(whereConditions, "exchange = ?")
                args = append(args, exchange)
        }

        if segment != "" {
                whereConditions = append(whereConditions, "segment = ?")
                args = append(args, segment)
        }

        // Build the full WHERE clause
        whereClause := ""
        if len(whereConditions) > 0 {
                whereClause = "WHERE " + strings.Join(whereConditions, " AND ")
        }

        // Query to get filtered and paginated data
        query := fmt.Sprintf(`
                SELECT 
                        id, 
                        exchange, 
                        segment, 
                        symbol, 
                        instrument, 
                        start_date, 
                        expiry
                FROM sutram.instrument_master
                %s
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
        `, whereClause)

        // Add limit and offset to the arguments
        args = append(args, limit, offset)

        // Execute the query
        var instrumentMasters []*model.InstrumentMaster
        err := r.db.SelectContext(ctx, &instrumentMasters, query, args...)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("error querying instrument masters with filters: %w", err)
        }

        // Count query to get total records matching the filter
        countQuery := fmt.Sprintf(`
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM sutram.instrument_master
                %s
        `, whereClause)

        // Execute the count query
        var totalCount int
        err = r.db.GetContext(ctx, &totalCount, countQuery, args[:len(args)-2]...) // Exclude limit and offset from count query
        if err != nil {
                return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("error counting instrument masters with filters: %w", err)
        }

        return instrumentMasters, totalCount, nil
}

// FindByIDs finds multiple instrument masters by their IDs
func (r *InstrumentMasterRepository) FindByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []uint64) ([]*model.InstrumentMaster, error) {
        if len(ids) == 0 {
                return []*model.InstrumentMaster{}, nil
        }

        // Convert the slice of IDs to a comma-separated string for the IN clause
        placeholders := make([]string, len(ids))
        args := make([]interface{}, len(ids))
        for i, id := range ids {
                placeholders[i] = "?"
                args[i] = id
        }

        query := fmt.Sprintf(`
                SELECT 
                        id, 
                        exchange, 
                        segment, 
                        symbol, 
                        instrument, 
                        start_date, 
                        expiry
                FROM sutram.instrument_master
                WHERE id IN (%s)
        `, strings.Join(placeholders, ","))

        instrumentMasters := []*model.InstrumentMaster{}
        err := r.db.SelectContext(ctx, &instrumentMasters, query, args...)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error querying instrument masters by IDs: %w", err)
        }

        return instrumentMasters, nil
}

package clickhouse

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/repository"

        "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)

// InstrumentRepository is a ClickHouse implementation of the InstrumentRepository interface
type InstrumentRepository struct {
        db *sqlx.DB
}

// NewInstrumentRepository creates a new ClickHouse instrument repository
func NewInstrumentRepository(db *sqlx.DB) repository.InstrumentRepository {
        return &InstrumentRepository{
                db: db,
        }
}

// FindByExchangeSecurityID finds instruments by exchange security ID
func (r *InstrumentRepository) FindByExchangeSecurityID(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32) ([]*model.Instrument, error) {
        query := `
                SELECT 
                        exchange_security_id, 
                        open, 
                        high, 
                        low, 
                        close, 
                        volume, 
                        timestamp, 
                        created_at, 
                        updated_at
                FROM sutram.instrument
                WHERE exchange_security_id = ?
                ORDER BY timestamp DESC
        `

        var instruments []*model.Instrument
        err := r.db.SelectContext(ctx, &instruments, query, exchangeSecurityID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error querying instruments by exchange security ID: %w", err)
        }

        return instruments, nil
}

// FindByExchangeSecurityIDAndTimeRange finds instruments by exchange security ID within a time range
// timeFrame parameter allows data aggregation by different time intervals ('1s', '1m', '3m', '5m', '15m', '30m', '1h', '3h', '1d', '1M')
func (r *InstrumentRepository) FindByExchangeSecurityIDAndTimeRange(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32, start, end time.Time, timeFrame string) ([]*model.Instrument, error) {
        query := `
                SELECT
                        exchange_security_id,
                        CASE
                                WHEN ? = '1s' THEN toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata')
                                WHEN ? = '1m' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)
                                WHEN ? = '3m' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 3 MINUTE)
                                WHEN ? = '5m' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
                                WHEN ? = '15m' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
                                WHEN ? = '30m' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
                                WHEN ? = '1h' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
                                WHEN ? = '3h' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
                                WHEN ? = '1d' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                                WHEN ? = '1M' THEN toStartOfInterval(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
                        END AS timestamp,
                        MIN(low) AS low,
                        MAX(high) AS high,
                        first_value(open) AS open,
                        last_value(close) AS close,
                        SUM(volume) AS volume,
                        MIN(created_at) AS created_at,
                        MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at
                FROM sutram.instrument
                WHERE 
                        exchange_security_id = ? AND
                        timestamp BETWEEN ? AND ?
                GROUP BY
                        exchange_security_id,
                        timestamp
                ORDER BY
                        timestamp ASC
        `

        var instruments []*model.Instrument
        err := r.db.SelectContext(ctx, &instruments, query,
                timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame,
                timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame, timeFrame,
                exchangeSecurityID, start, end)

        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error querying instruments by exchange security ID and time range: %w", err)
        }

        return instruments, nil
}

// Create creates a new instrument
func (r *InstrumentRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, instrument *model.Instrument) error {
        query := `
                INSERT INTO sutram.instrument (
                        exchange_security_id,
                        open,
                        high,
                        low,
                        close,
                        volume,
                        timestamp,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `

        _, err := r.db.ExecContext(
                ctx,
                query,
                instrument.ExchangeSecurityID,
                instrument.Open,
                instrument.High,
                instrument.Low,
                instrument.Close,
                instrument.Volume,
                instrument.Timestamp,
                instrument.CreatedAt,
                instrument.UpdatedAt,
        )

        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error creating instrument: %w", err)
        }

        return nil
}

// Update updates an instrument
func (r *InstrumentRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, instrument *model.Instrument) error {
        // Note: In ClickHouse, we don't really update rows, we insert new rows with updated values
        // This is a simplified version assuming you have a way to handle this in your application
        query := `
                ALTER TABLE instrument UPDATE
                        open = ?,
                        high = ?,
                        low = ?,
                        close = ?,
                        volume = ?,
                        updated_at = ?
                WHERE exchange_security_id = ? AND timestamp = ?
        `

        _, err := r.db.ExecContext(
                ctx,
                query,
                instrument.Open,
                instrument.High,
                instrument.Low,
                instrument.Close,
                instrument.Volume,
                instrument.UpdatedAt,
                instrument.ExchangeSecurityID,
                instrument.Timestamp,
        )

        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error updating instrument: %w", err)
        }

        return nil
}

// Delete deletes instruments by exchange security ID
func (r *InstrumentRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, exchangeSecurityID int32) error {
        query := `
                ALTER TABLE instrument DELETE WHERE exchange_security_id = ?
        `

        _, err := r.db.ExecContext(ctx, query, exchangeSecurityID)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("error deleting instruments: %w", err)
        }

        return nil
}

package http

import (
        "net/http"
        "strconv"
        "strings"

        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/application/dto"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/application/service"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"

        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// InstrumentController handles instrument-related HTTP requests
type InstrumentController struct {
        instrumentService *service.InstrumentService
}

// NewInstrumentController creates a new instrument controller
func NewInstrumentController(instrumentService *service.InstrumentService) *InstrumentController {
        return &InstrumentController{
                instrumentService: instrumentService,
        }
}

// GetInstrumentByExchangeSecurityID gets instruments by exchange security ID
func (c *InstrumentController) GetInstrumentByExchangeSecurityID(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get exchange security ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        exchangeSecurityID, err := strconv.ParseInt(idParam, 10, 32)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid exchange security ID",
                })
                return
        }

        // Get the instruments
        instruments, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentsByExchangeSecurityID(ctx.Request.Context(), int32(exchangeSecurityID))
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument models to DTOs
        instrumentDTOs := make([]*dto.InstrumentDTO, len(instruments))
        for i, instrument := range instruments {
                instrumentDTOs[i] = modelToDTO(instrument)
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Data:    instrumentDTOs,
        })
}

// GetInstrumentMasterByID gets an instrument master by ID
func (c *InstrumentController) GetInstrumentMasterByID(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get instrument master ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idParam, 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid instrument master ID",
                })
                return
        }

        // Get the instrument master
        instrumentMaster, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentMasterByID(ctx.Request.Context(), id)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument master model to DTO
        instrumentMasterDTO := masterModelToDTO(instrumentMaster)

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Data:    instrumentMasterDTO,
        })
}

// GetInstrumentsByTimeRange gets instruments by exchange security ID within a time range
func (c *InstrumentController) GetInstrumentsByTimeRange(ctx *gin.Context) {
        var req dto.GetInstrumentsByTimeRangeRequest
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid request: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Get instruments by time range
        timeFrame := req.TimeFrame
        if timeFrame == "" {
                timeFrame = "1m" // Default to 1-minute timeframe if not specified
        }

        instruments, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentsByTimeRange(
                ctx.Request.Context(),
                req.ExchangeSecurityID,
                req.StartTime,
                req.EndTime,
                timeFrame,
        )
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to get instruments: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument models to DTOs
        instrumentDTOs := make([]*dto.InstrumentDTO, len(instruments))
        for i, instrument := range instruments {
                instrumentDTOs[i] = modelToDTO(instrument)
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Data:    instrumentDTOs,
        })
}

// GetAllInstrumentMasters gets all instrument masters with pagination and filtering
func (c *InstrumentController) GetAllInstrumentMasters(ctx *gin.Context) {
        var filter dto.InstrumentMasterFilterDTO
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindQuery(&filter); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid filter parameters: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Get instrument masters with filtering and pagination
        instrumentMasters, totalCount, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentMastersWithFilters(
                ctx.Request.Context(),
                filter.Exchange,
                filter.Segment,
                filter.Page,
                filter.PageSize,
        )
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to get instrument masters: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument master models to DTOs
        instrumentMasterDTOs := make([]*dto.InstrumentMasterDTO, len(instrumentMasters))
        for i, instrumentMaster := range instrumentMasters {
                instrumentMasterDTOs[i] = masterModelToDTO(instrumentMaster)
        }

        // Calculate total pages
        totalPages := totalCount / filter.PageSize
        if totalCount%filter.PageSize > 0 {
                totalPages++
        }

        // Create paginated response
        paginatedResponse := dto.PaginatedResponse{
                Data:       instrumentMasterDTOs,
                Page:       filter.Page,
                PageSize:   filter.PageSize,
                TotalCount: totalCount,
                TotalPages: totalPages,
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Data:    paginatedResponse,
        })
}

// GetInstrumentMastersByIDs gets instrument masters by their IDs
func (c *InstrumentController) GetInstrumentMastersByIDs(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get IDs from query parameter - expected format: ?ids=1,2,3,4
        idsParam := ctx.Query("ids")
        if idsParam == "" {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Missing required query parameter: ids",
                })
                return
        }

        // Split the comma-separated IDs and parse them to uint64
        idStrings := strings.Split(idsParam, ",")
        ids := make([]uint64, 0, len(idStrings))

        for _, idStr := range idStrings {
                id, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimSpace(idStr), 10, 64)
                if err != nil {
                        ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                                Success: false,
                                Error:   "Invalid ID format: " + idStr,
                        })
                        return
                }
                ids = append(ids, id)
        }

        // Get instrument masters
        instrumentMasters := make([]*model.InstrumentMaster, 0, len(ids))
        for _, id := range ids {
                instrumentMaster, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentMasterByID(ctx.Request.Context(), id)
                if err == nil && instrumentMaster != nil {
                        instrumentMasters = append(instrumentMasters, instrumentMaster)
                }
        }

        // Convert instrument master models to DTOs
        instrumentMasterDTOs := make([]*dto.InstrumentMasterDTO, len(instrumentMasters))
        for i, instrumentMaster := range instrumentMasters {
                instrumentMasterDTOs[i] = masterModelToDTO(instrumentMaster)
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Data:    instrumentMasterDTOs,
        })
}

// CreateInstrument creates a new instrument
func (c *InstrumentController) CreateInstrument(ctx *gin.Context) {
        var req dto.CreateInstrumentRequest
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid request: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Create instrument from request
        instrument := &model.Instrument{
                ExchangeSecurityID: req.ExchangeSecurityID,
                Open:               req.Open,
                High:               req.High,
                Low:                req.Low,
                Close:              req.Close,
                Volume:             req.Volume,
                Timestamp:          req.Timestamp,
        }

        // Create the instrument
        err := c.instrumentService.CreateInstrument(ctx.Request.Context(), instrument)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to create instrument: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument model to DTO
        instrumentDTO := modelToDTO(instrument)

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusCreated, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instrument created successfully",
                Data:    instrumentDTO,
        })
}

// UpdateInstrument updates an instrument
func (c *InstrumentController) UpdateInstrument(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get exchange security ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        exchangeSecurityID, err := strconv.ParseInt(idParam, 10, 32)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid exchange security ID",
                })
                return
        }

        var req dto.UpdateInstrumentRequest
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid request: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // We need the timestamp from the request to identify the specific instrument
        if req.Timestamp.IsZero() {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Timestamp is required for updates",
                })
                return
        }

        // Get existing instruments for this exchange security ID
        instruments, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentsByExchangeSecurityID(ctx.Request.Context(), int32(exchangeSecurityID))
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Find the specific instrument with matching timestamp
        var instrument *model.Instrument
        for _, inst := range instruments {
                if inst.Timestamp.Equal(req.Timestamp) {
                        instrument = inst
                        break
                }
        }

        if instrument == nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "No instrument found with the specified timestamp",
                })
                return
        }

        // Update instrument fields
        instrument.Open = req.Open
        instrument.High = req.High
        instrument.Low = req.Low
        instrument.Close = req.Close
        instrument.Volume = req.Volume

        // Update the instrument
        err = c.instrumentService.UpdateInstrument(ctx.Request.Context(), instrument)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to update instrument: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument model to DTO
        instrumentDTO := modelToDTO(instrument)

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instrument updated successfully",
                Data:    instrumentDTO,
        })
}

// CreateInstrumentMaster creates a new instrument master
func (c *InstrumentController) CreateInstrumentMaster(ctx *gin.Context) {
        var req dto.CreateInstrumentMasterRequest
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid request: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Create instrument master from request
        instrumentMaster := &model.InstrumentMaster{
                Exchange:  req.Exchange,
                Segment:   req.Segment,
                Symbol:    req.Symbol,
                Name:      req.Name,
                StartDate: req.StartDate,
                Expiry:    req.Expiry,
        }

        // Create the instrument master
        err := c.instrumentService.CreateInstrumentMaster(ctx.Request.Context(), instrumentMaster)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to create instrument master: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument master model to DTO
        instrumentMasterDTO := masterModelToDTO(instrumentMaster)

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusCreated, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instrument master created successfully",
                Data:    instrumentMasterDTO,
        })
}

// UpdateInstrumentMaster updates an instrument master
func (c *InstrumentController) UpdateInstrumentMaster(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get instrument master ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idParam, 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid instrument master ID",
                })
                return
        }

        var req dto.UpdateInstrumentMasterRequest
        if err := ctx.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid request: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Get existing instrument master
        instrumentMaster, err := c.instrumentService.GetInstrumentMasterByID(ctx.Request.Context(), id)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Update instrument master fields
        if req.Exchange != "" {
                instrumentMaster.Exchange = req.Exchange
        }
        if req.Segment != "" {
                instrumentMaster.Segment = req.Segment
        }
        if req.Symbol != "" {
                instrumentMaster.Symbol = req.Symbol
        }
        if req.Name != "" {
                instrumentMaster.Name = req.Name
        }
        if !req.StartDate.IsZero() {
                instrumentMaster.StartDate = req.StartDate
        }
        if !req.Expiry.IsZero() {
                instrumentMaster.Expiry = req.Expiry
        }

        // Update the instrument master
        err = c.instrumentService.UpdateInstrumentMaster(ctx.Request.Context(), instrumentMaster)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to update instrument master: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        // Convert instrument master model to DTO
        instrumentMasterDTO := masterModelToDTO(instrumentMaster)

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instrument master updated successfully",
                Data:    instrumentMasterDTO,
        })
}

// DeleteInstrument deletes instruments by exchange security ID
func (c *InstrumentController) DeleteInstrument(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get exchange security ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        exchangeSecurityID, err := strconv.ParseInt(idParam, 10, 32)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid exchange security ID",
                })
                return
        }

        // Delete the instruments with the specified exchange security ID
        err = c.instrumentService.DeleteInstrument(ctx.Request.Context(), int32(exchangeSecurityID))
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to delete instruments: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instruments deleted successfully",
        })
}

// DeleteInstrumentMaster deletes an instrument master
func (c *InstrumentController) DeleteInstrumentMaster(ctx *gin.Context) {
        // Get instrument master ID from URL parameter
        idParam := ctx.Param("id")
        id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idParam, 10, 64)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Invalid instrument master ID",
                })
                return
        }

        // Delete the instrument master
        err = c.instrumentService.DeleteInstrumentMaster(ctx.Request.Context(), id)
        if err != nil {
                ctx.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, dto.ApiResponse{
                        Success: false,
                        Error:   "Failed to delete instrument master: " + err.Error(),
                })
                return
        }

        ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, dto.ApiResponse{
                Success: true,
                Message: "Instrument master deleted successfully",
        })
}

// Helper function to convert instrument model to DTO
func modelToDTO(instrument *model.Instrument) *dto.InstrumentDTO {
        if instrument == nil {
                return nil
        }

        return &dto.InstrumentDTO{
                ExchangeSecurityID: instrument.ExchangeSecurityID,
                Open:               instrument.Open,
                High:               instrument.High,
                Low:                instrument.Low,
                Close:              instrument.Close,
                Volume:             instrument.Volume,
                Timestamp:          instrument.Timestamp,
        }
}

// Helper function to convert instrument master model to DTO
func masterModelToDTO(master *model.InstrumentMaster) *dto.InstrumentMasterDTO {
        if master == nil {
                return nil
        }

        return &dto.InstrumentMasterDTO{
                ID:                 master.ID,
                ExchangeSecurityID: master.ExchangeSecurityID,
                Exchange:           master.Exchange,
                Segment:            master.Segment,
                Symbol:             master.Symbol,
                Name:               master.Name,
                StartDate:          master.StartDate,
                Expiry:             master.Expiry,
        }
}

package http

import (
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// RegisterRoutes registers the instrument module routes
func RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup, controller *InstrumentController) {
        // Instrument routes
        instruments := router.Group("/instrument")
        {
                instruments.GET("/:id", controller.GetInstrumentByExchangeSecurityID)
                instruments.PUT("/:id", controller.UpdateInstrument)
                instruments.DELETE("/:id", controller.DeleteInstrument)
                instruments.POST("", controller.CreateInstrument)
                instruments.POST("/timerange", controller.GetInstrumentsByTimeRange)
        }

        // Instrument master routes
        masters := router.Group("/instrument-master")
        {
                masters.GET("", controller.GetAllInstrumentMasters)
                masters.GET("/by-ids", controller.GetInstrumentMastersByIDs)
                masters.GET("/:id", controller.GetInstrumentMasterByID)
                masters.PUT("/:id", controller.UpdateInstrumentMaster)
                masters.DELETE("/:id", controller.DeleteInstrumentMaster)
                masters.POST("", controller.CreateInstrumentMaster)
        }
}

package instrument

import (
        infraRepo "algo/internal/infra/persistance/repository"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/application/service"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/infrastructure/persistence/clickhouse"
        "algo/internal/modules/instrument/interfaces/http"

        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "github.com/google/wire"
        "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)

// Module represents the instrument module
type Module struct {
        db                *sqlx.DB
        controller        *http.InstrumentController
        instrumentService *service.InstrumentService
}

// ProvideModule provides a wire provider set for the instrument module
var ProvideModule = wire.NewSet(
        ProvideInstrumentModule,
)

// ProvideInstrumentModule provides an instrument module instance
func ProvideInstrumentModule() (*Module, error) {
        return New(), nil
}

// New creates a new instrument module
func New() *Module {
        // Get database connection
        db, err := infraRepo.ProvideClickHouseDB()
        if err != nil {
                panic(err) // In a real app, handle this more gracefully
        }

        module := &Module{
                db: db,
        }

        // Initialize module components
        module.initialize()

        return module
}

// initialize sets up the instrument module
func (m *Module) initialize() {
        // Create repositories
        instrumentRepo := clickhouse.NewInstrumentRepository(m.db)
        instrumentMasterRepo := clickhouse.NewInstrumentMasterRepository(m.db)

        // Create services
        m.instrumentService = service.NewInstrumentService(instrumentRepo, instrumentMasterRepo)

        // Create controller
        m.controller = http.NewInstrumentController(m.instrumentService)
}

// RegisterRoutes registers the instrument module routes with the given router
func (m *Module) RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        http.RegisterRoutes(router, m.controller)
}

// GetController returns the instrument controller
func (m *Module) GetController() *http.InstrumentController {
        return m.controller
}

// GetInstrumentService returns the instrument service
func (m *Module) GetInstrumentService() *service.InstrumentService {
        return m.instrumentService
}

// filepath: /Users/amit/workspace/sutram/internal/modules/marketplace/application/dto/common.go
package dto

// ApiResponse is a common response structure
type ApiResponse struct {
        Success bool        `json:"success"`
        Message string      `json:"message,omitempty"`
        Error   string      `json:"error,omitempty"`
        Data    interface{} `json:"data,omitempty"`
}

// PaginatedResponse is a paginated response
type PaginatedResponse struct {
        Total      int         `json:"total"`
        Page       int         `json:"page"`
        PerPage    int         `json:"per_page"`
        TotalPages int         `json:"total_pages"`
        HasMore    bool        `json:"has_more"`
        Data       interface{} `json:"data"`
}

// NewPaginatedResponse creates a new paginated response
func NewPaginatedResponse(data interface{}, total, page, perPage int) PaginatedResponse {
        totalPages := total / perPage
        if total%perPage > 0 {
                totalPages++
        }

        return PaginatedResponse{
                Total:      total,
                Page:       page,
                PerPage:    perPage,
                TotalPages: totalPages,
                HasMore:    page < totalPages,
                Data:       data,
        }
}

package dto

import (
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/model"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateListingRequest represents a request to create a new marketplace listing
type CreateListingRequest struct {
        StrategyID       uuid.UUID `json:"strategy_id" binding:"required"`
        Title            string    `json:"title" binding:"required,min=5,max=255"`
        Description      string    `json:"description" binding:"required"`
        Price            float64   `json:"price" binding:"required,min=0"`
        SubscriptionType string    `json:"subscription_type" binding:"required,oneof=one-time monthly yearly"`
        CategoryIDs      []string  `json:"category_ids" binding:"required,dive,uuid4"`
        Features         []string  `json:"features" binding:"omitempty,dive,max=100"`
}

// UpdateListingRequest represents a request to update a marketplace listing
type UpdateListingRequest struct {
        Title            string   `json:"title" binding:"omitempty,min=5,max=255"`
        Description      string   `json:"description"`
        Price            float64  `json:"price" binding:"omitempty,min=0"`
        SubscriptionType string   `json:"subscription_type" binding:"omitempty,oneof=one-time monthly yearly"`
        CategoryIDs      []string `json:"category_ids" binding:"omitempty,dive,uuid4"`
        Features         []string `json:"features" binding:"omitempty,dive,max=100"`
        IsActive         *bool    `json:"is_active"`
}

// ListingResponse represents a marketplace listing response
type ListingResponse struct {
        ID               uuid.UUID            `json:"id"`
        StrategyID       uuid.UUID            `json:"strategy_id"`
        UserID           uuid.UUID            `json:"user_id"`
        SellerName       string               `json:"seller_name,omitempty"`
        Title            string               `json:"title"`
        Description      string               `json:"description"`
        Price            float64              `json:"price"`
        SubscriptionType string               `json:"subscription_type"`
        IsFeatured       bool                 `json:"is_featured"`
        IsActive         bool                 `json:"is_active"`
        Views            int                  `json:"views"`
        Ratings          float32              `json:"ratings"`
        CreatedAt        time.Time            `json:"created_at"`
        UpdatedAt        time.Time            `json:"updated_at"`
        Categories       []CategoryResponse   `json:"categories,omitempty"`
        Performance      *PerformanceResponse `json:"performance,omitempty"`
        Features         []string             `json:"features,omitempty"`
}

// ListingFilterRequest represents filters for listing API
type ListingFilterRequest struct {
        Category string `form:"category"`
        Sort     string `form:"sort" binding:"omitempty,oneof=newest price rating popularity"`
        Search   string `form:"search"`
        PriceMin string `form:"price_min"`
        PriceMax string `form:"price_max"`
        Page     int    `form:"page,default=1" binding:"min=1"`
        PerPage  int    `form:"per_page,default=20" binding:"min=1,max=100"`
}

// ToListingResponse converts a model.Listing to a ListingResponse
func ToListingResponse(listing *model.Listing) ListingResponse {
        var categoryResponses []CategoryResponse
        if len(listing.Categories) > 0 {
                categoryResponses = make([]CategoryResponse, len(listing.Categories))
                for i, category := range listing.Categories {
                        categoryResponses[i] = CategoryResponse{
                                ID:   category.ID,
                                Name: category.Name,
                        }
                }
        }

        var performanceResponse *PerformanceResponse
        if listing.Performance != nil {
                performanceResponse = &PerformanceResponse{
                        SharpeRatio:        listing.Performance.SharpeRatio,
                        SortinoRatio:       listing.Performance.SortinoRatio,
                        TotalReturnPct:     listing.Performance.TotalReturnPct,
                        AnnualizedReturn:   listing.Performance.AnnualizedReturn,
                        MaxDrawdown:        listing.Performance.MaxDrawdown,
                        WinRate:            listing.Performance.WinRate,
                        ProfitFactor:       listing.Performance.ProfitFactor,
                        BacktestPeriodDays: listing.Performance.BacktestPeriodDays,
                }
        }

        return ListingResponse{
                ID:               listing.ID,
                StrategyID:       listing.StrategyID,
                UserID:           listing.UserID,
                Title:            listing.Title,
                Description:      listing.Description,
                Price:            listing.Price,
                SubscriptionType: string(listing.SubscriptionType),
                IsFeatured:       listing.IsFeatured,
                IsActive:         listing.IsActive,
                Views:            listing.Views,
                Ratings:          listing.Ratings,
                CreatedAt:        listing.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:        listing.UpdatedAt,
                Categories:       categoryResponses,
                Performance:      performanceResponse,
                Features:         listing.Features,
        }
}

        if subscription.Listing != nil {
                listingResponse = ToListingResponse(subscription.Listing)
        }

        return SubscriptionResponse{
                ID:               subscription.ID,
                ListingID:        subscription.ListingID,
                Listing:          listingResponse,
                Status:           string(subscription.Status),
                SubscriptionType: string(subscription.SubscriptionType),

                CreatedAt:        subscription.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedAt:        subscription.UpdatedAt,
        }

package service

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"

        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/repository"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CategoryService handles marketplace category business logic
type CategoryService struct {
        categoryRepo repository.CategoryRepository
}

// NewCategoryService creates a new category service
func NewCategoryService(categoryRepo repository.CategoryRepository) *CategoryService {
        return &CategoryService{
                categoryRepo: categoryRepo,
        }
}

// GetAllCategories retrieves all marketplace categories
func (s *CategoryService) GetAllCategories(ctx context.Context) ([]model.Category, error) {
        categories, err := s.categoryRepo.FindAll(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get categories: %w", err)
        }

        return categories, nil
}

// GetCategoryByID retrieves a category by ID
func (s *CategoryService) GetCategoryByID(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*model.Category, error) {
        category, err := s.categoryRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get category: %w", err)
        }

        if category == nil {
                return nil, ErrCategoryNotFound
        }

        return category, nil
}

// GetCategoriesByIDs retrieves categories by their IDs
func (s *CategoryService) GetCategoriesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []uuid.UUID) ([]model.Category, error) {
        if len(ids) == 0 {
                return []model.Category{}, nil
        }

        categories, err := s.categoryRepo.FindByIDs(ctx, ids)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get categories by IDs: %w", err)
        }

        return categories, nil
}

// filepath: /Users/amit/workspace/sutram/internal/modules/marketplace/application/service/listing_service.go
package service

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "time"

        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/model"
        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/repository"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Common errors
var (
        ErrListingNotFound      = errors.New("listing not found")
        ErrCategoryNotFound     = errors.New("category not found")
        ErrUnauthorized         = errors.New("unauthorized")
        ErrInvalidListingData   = errors.New("invalid listing data")
        ErrListingAlreadyExists = errors.New("listing already exists for this strategy")
)

// ListingService handles marketplace listing business logic
type ListingService struct {
        listingRepo     repository.ListingRepository
        categoryRepo    repository.CategoryRepository
        performanceRepo repository.PerformanceRepository
}

// NewListingService creates a new listing service
func NewListingService(
        listingRepo repository.ListingRepository,
        categoryRepo repository.CategoryRepository,
        performanceRepo repository.PerformanceRepository,
) *ListingService {
        return &ListingService{
                listingRepo:     listingRepo,
                categoryRepo:    categoryRepo,
                performanceRepo: performanceRepo,
        }
}

// CreateListing creates a new marketplace listing
func (s *ListingService) CreateListing(
        ctx context.Context,
        userID uuid.UUID,
        strategyID uuid.UUID,
        title,
        description string,
        price float64,
        subscriptionType string,
        categoryIDs []uuid.UUID,
        features []string,
) (*model.Listing, error) {
        // Prepare the listing model
        listing := &model.Listing{
                ID:               uuid.New(),
                StrategyID:       strategyID,
                UserID:           userID,
                Title:            title,
                Description:      description,
                Price:            price,
                SubscriptionType: model.SubscriptionType(subscriptionType),
                IsFeatured:       false,
                IsActive:         true,
                Views:            0,
                CreatedAt:        time.Now(),
                UpdatedAt:        time.Now(),
        }

        // Create the listing
        if err := s.listingRepo.Create(ctx, listing); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create listing: %w", err)
        }

        // Add categories
        if err := s.listingRepo.AddCategories(ctx, listing.ID, categoryIDs); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add categories: %w", err)
        }

        // Store features if provided
        if len(features) > 0 {
                if err := s.listingRepo.SetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID, features); err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to set features: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Load categories
        categories, err := s.listingRepo.GetCategories(ctx, listing.ID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load categories: %w", err)
        }
        listing.Categories = categories

        // Load features
        listingFeatures, err := s.listingRepo.GetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load features: %w", err)
        }
        listing.Features = listingFeatures

        return listing, nil
}

// GetListingByID retrieves a listing by ID
func (s *ListingService) GetListingByID(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (*model.Listing, error) {
        // Get the listing
        listing, err := s.listingRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find listing: %w", err)
        }
        if listing == nil {
                return nil, ErrListingNotFound
        }

        // Load categories
        categories, err := s.listingRepo.GetCategories(ctx, listing.ID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load categories: %w", err)
        }
        listing.Categories = categories

        // Load features
        features, err := s.listingRepo.GetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load features: %w", err)
        }
        listing.Features = features

        // Load performance metrics
        performance, err := s.performanceRepo.FindByListingID(ctx, listing.ID)
        if err == nil && performance != nil {
                listing.Performance = performance
        }

        return listing, nil
}

// IncrementViews increments the view count for a listing
func (s *ListingService) IncrementViews(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID) error {
        return s.listingRepo.IncrementViews(ctx, id)
}

// GetListings retrieves listings with optional filtering
func (s *ListingService) GetListings(
        ctx context.Context,
        category string,
        sort string,
        search string,
        priceMin string,
        priceMax string,
        page int,
        perPage int,
) ([]*model.Listing, int, error) {
        // Build filter map
        filters := make(map[string]interface{})

        // Add category filter if provided
        if category != "" {
                // Find category by name
                cat, err := s.categoryRepo.FindByName(ctx, category)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to find category: %w", err)
                }
                if cat != nil {
                        filters["category_id"] = cat.ID
                }
        }

        // Add search filter
        if search != "" {
                filters["search"] = search
        }

        // Add price range filters
        if priceMin != "" {
                if min, err := strconv.ParseFloat(priceMin, 64); err == nil {
                        filters["price_min"] = min
                }
        }

        if priceMax != "" {
                if max, err := strconv.ParseFloat(priceMax, 64); err == nil {
                        filters["price_max"] = max
                }
        }

        // Add sort parameter
        if sort != "" {
                filters["sort"] = sort
        }

        // Only show active listings
        filters["is_active"] = true

        // Get listings with filters
        listings, total, err := s.listingRepo.FindAll(ctx, filters, page, perPage)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to find listings: %w", err)
        }

        // Load additional data for each listing
        for _, listing := range listings {
                // Load categories
                categories, err := s.listingRepo.GetCategories(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil {
                        listing.Categories = categories
                }

                // Load performance
                performance, err := s.performanceRepo.FindByListingID(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil && performance != nil {
                        listing.Performance = performance
                }

                // Load features
                features, err := s.listingRepo.GetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil {
                        listing.Features = features
                }
        }

        return listings, total, nil
}

// UpdateListing updates an existing listing
func (s *ListingService) UpdateListing(
        ctx context.Context,
        id uuid.UUID,
        userID uuid.UUID,
        updates map[string]interface{},
) (*model.Listing, error) {
        // Get the existing listing
        listing, err := s.listingRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find listing: %w", err)
        }
        if listing == nil {
                return nil, ErrListingNotFound
        }

        // Check if user owns the listing
        if listing.UserID != userID {
                return nil, ErrUnauthorized
        }

        // Update fields
        if title, ok := updates["title"].(string); ok && title != "" {
                listing.Title = title
        }

        if description, ok := updates["description"].(string); ok {
                listing.Description = description
        }

        if price, ok := updates["price"].(float64); ok && price > 0 {
                listing.Price = price
        }

        if subscriptionType, ok := updates["subscription_type"].(string); ok && subscriptionType != "" {
                listing.SubscriptionType = model.SubscriptionType(subscriptionType)
        }

        if isActivePtr, ok := updates["is_active"].(*bool); ok && isActivePtr != nil {
                listing.IsActive = *isActivePtr
        }

        // Update timestamp
        listing.UpdatedAt = time.Now()

        // Save the updated listing
        if err := s.listingRepo.Update(ctx, listing); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update listing: %w", err)
        }

        // Update categories if provided
        if categoryIDs, ok := updates["category_ids"].([]uuid.UUID); ok && len(categoryIDs) > 0 {
                // First remove all existing categories
                existingCategories, err := s.listingRepo.GetCategories(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get existing categories: %w", err)
                }

                var existingCategoryIDs []uuid.UUID
                for _, category := range existingCategories {
                        existingCategoryIDs = append(existingCategoryIDs, category.ID)
                }

                if len(existingCategoryIDs) > 0 {
                        if err := s.listingRepo.RemoveCategories(ctx, listing.ID, existingCategoryIDs); err != nil {
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to remove existing categories: %w", err)
                        }
                }

                // Then add the new categories
                if err := s.listingRepo.AddCategories(ctx, listing.ID, categoryIDs); err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add new categories: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Update features if provided
        if features, ok := updates["features"].([]string); ok {
                if err := s.listingRepo.SetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID, features); err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update features: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Reload the listing with all related data
        return s.GetListingByID(ctx, id)
}

// DeleteListing deletes a listing
func (s *ListingService) DeleteListing(ctx context.Context, id uuid.UUID, userID uuid.UUID) error {
        // Get the listing
        listing, err := s.listingRepo.FindByID(ctx, id)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to find listing: %w", err)
        }
        if listing == nil {
                return ErrListingNotFound
        }

        // Check if user owns the listing
        if listing.UserID != userID {
                return ErrUnauthorized
        }

        // Delete the listing
        if err := s.listingRepo.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete listing: %w", err)
        }

        return nil
}

// UpdatePerformanceMetrics updates performance metrics for a listing
func (s *ListingService) UpdatePerformanceMetrics(
        ctx context.Context,
        listingID uuid.UUID,
        userID uuid.UUID,
        metrics *model.Performance,
) error {
        // Get the listing
        listing, err := s.listingRepo.FindByID(ctx, listingID)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to find listing: %w", err)
        }
        if listing == nil {
                return ErrListingNotFound
        }

        // Check if user owns the listing
        if listing.UserID != userID {
                return ErrUnauthorized
        }

        // Check if performance exists
        existing, err := s.performanceRepo.FindByListingID(ctx, listingID)
        if err != nil && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to find performance: %w", err)
        }

        metrics.ListingID = listingID
        metrics.UpdatedAt = time.Now()

        if existing == nil {
                // Create new performance entry
                if err := s.performanceRepo.Create(ctx, metrics); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to create performance metrics: %w", err)
                }
        } else {
                // Update existing performance entry
                if err := s.performanceRepo.Update(ctx, metrics); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to update performance metrics: %w", err)
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// GetListingsByUserID gets all listings by user ID
func (s *ListingService) GetListingsByUserID(ctx context.Context, userID uuid.UUID) ([]*model.Listing, error) {
        listings, err := s.listingRepo.FindByUserID(ctx, userID)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find listings by user ID: %w", err)
        }

        // Load additional data for each listing
        for _, listing := range listings {
                // Load categories
                categories, err := s.listingRepo.GetCategories(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil {
                        listing.Categories = categories
                }

                // Load performance
                performance, err := s.performanceRepo.FindByListingID(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil && performance != nil {
                        listing.Performance = performance
                }

                // Load features
                features, err := s.listingRepo.GetFeatures(ctx, listing.ID)
                if err == nil {
                        listing.Features = features
                }
        }

        return listings, nil
}

package service

import (

        "algo/internal/modules/marketplace/domain/repository"
