package parser

import instrument "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"

type Indicator struct {
        Type    string         `json:"type"`  /// Indicator / Number
        Name    string         `json:"name"`  /// SMA / EMA / RSI
        Point   string         `json:"point"` /// OHLC
        Value   map[string]any `json:"value"`
        Returns string         `json:"returns"`
}

type Prices []float64

type IndicatorCalculator interface {
        Calculate(config []any, ctx *EvaluationContext) float64
        SliceData(prices Prices) Prices
        GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32
}

func (indicator *Indicator) GetDataRange() int32 {
        calculator := GetIndFactory(indicator.Name)
        return calculator.GetDataRange(indicator.Value)
}

func GetPrices(data instrument.StockData, point string) Prices {
        var results Prices

        for _, d := range data {
                var value float64
                switch point {
                case "OPEN":
                        value = d.Open
                case "HIGH":
                        value = d.High
                case "CLOSE":
                        value = d.Close
                case "LOW":
                        value = d.Low
                case "VOLUME":
                        value = float64(d.Volume)
                default:
                        value = d.Close
                }
                results = append(results, value)
        }

        return results
}
package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
        "math"
)

type KeltnerChannels struct {
        emaPeriod  int
        atrPeriod  int
        multiplier float64
        offset     int
}

func (indicator *KeltnerChannels) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Keltner Channels properly
        maxPeriod := max(indicator.emaPeriod, indicator.atrPeriod)
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*maxPeriod))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *KeltnerChannels) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate Keltner Channels properly
        maxPeriod := max(indicator.emaPeriod, indicator.atrPeriod)
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+2*maxPeriod))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *KeltnerChannels) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        emaPeriod := int(config[0].(float64))
        atrPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        multiplier := float64(config[2].(float64))
        offset := int(config[3].(float64))

        indicator.emaPeriod = emaPeriod
        indicator.atrPeriod = atrPeriod
        indicator.multiplier = multiplier
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        maxPeriod := max(emaPeriod, atrPeriod)
        if len(highs) < maxPeriod+offset+1 || len(lows) < maxPeriod+offset+1 || len(closes) < maxPeriod+offset+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes)

        // Need at least maxPeriod+1 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < maxPeriod+1 || len(lows) < maxPeriod+1 || len(closes) < maxPeriod+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate EMA of typical price (middle line)
        var typicalPrices = make([]float64, len(closes))
        for i := 0; i < len(closes); i++ {
                typicalPrices[i] = (highs[i] + lows[i] + closes[i]) / 3.0
        }

        // Calculate EMA
        multiplierEMA := 2.0 / float64(indicator.emaPeriod+1)
        var emaSum float64
        for i := 0; i < indicator.emaPeriod; i++ {
                emaSum += typicalPrices[i]
        }
        ema := emaSum / float64(indicator.emaPeriod)

        var emas = make([]float64, len(closes))
        emas[indicator.emaPeriod-1] = ema

        for i := indicator.emaPeriod; i < len(closes); i++ {
                ema = (typicalPrices[i]-ema)*multiplierEMA + ema
                emas[i] = ema
        }

        // Calculate ATR (Average True Range)
        var tr = make([]float64, len(closes))

        // Calculate True Range
        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                tr[i] = max(
                        highs[i]-lows[i],
                        max(
                                math.Abs(highs[i]-closes[i-1]),
                                math.Abs(lows[i]-closes[i-1]),
                        ),
                )
        }

        // Calculate initial ATR as simple average of TR
        var atrSum float64
        for i := 1; i <= indicator.atrPeriod; i++ {
                atrSum += tr[i]
        }
        atr := atrSum / float64(indicator.atrPeriod)

        var atrs = make([]float64, len(closes))
        atrs[indicator.atrPeriod] = atr

        // Calculate subsequent ATR values
        for i := indicator.atrPeriod + 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                atr = ((atr * float64(indicator.atrPeriod-1)) + tr[i]) / float64(indicator.atrPeriod)
                atrs[i] = atr
        }

        // Calculate upper and lower bands
        var upperBand = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var lowerBand = make([]float64, len(closes))

        maxIndex := max(indicator.emaPeriod, indicator.atrPeriod+1)
        for i := maxIndex; i < len(closes); i++ {
                upperBand[i] = emas[i] + indicator.multiplier*atrs[i]
                lowerBand[i] = emas[i] - indicator.multiplier*atrs[i]
        }

        // Return the middle line (EMA)
        return util.Round(emas[len(emas)-1])
}

func (indicator *KeltnerChannels) CalculateAll(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) (float64, float64, float64) {
        emaPeriod := int(config[0].(float64))
        atrPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        multiplier := float64(config[2].(float64))
        offset := int(config[3].(float64))

        indicator.emaPeriod = emaPeriod
        indicator.atrPeriod = atrPeriod
        indicator.multiplier = multiplier
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        maxPeriod := max(emaPeriod, atrPeriod)
        if len(highs) < maxPeriod+offset+1 || len(lows) < maxPeriod+offset+1 || len(closes) < maxPeriod+offset+1 {
                return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes)

        // Need at least maxPeriod+1 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < maxPeriod+1 || len(lows) < maxPeriod+1 || len(closes) < maxPeriod+1 {
                return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        }

        // Calculate EMA of typical price (middle line)
        var typicalPrices = make([]float64, len(closes))
        for i := 0; i < len(closes); i++ {
                typicalPrices[i] = (highs[i] + lows[i] + closes[i]) / 3.0
        }

        // Calculate EMA
        multiplierEMA := 2.0 / float64(indicator.emaPeriod+1)
        var emaSum float64
        for i := 0; i < indicator.emaPeriod; i++ {
                emaSum += typicalPrices[i]
        }
        ema := emaSum / float64(indicator.emaPeriod)

        var emas = make([]float64, len(closes))
        emas[indicator.emaPeriod-1] = ema

        for i := indicator.emaPeriod; i < len(closes); i++ {
                ema = (typicalPrices[i]-ema)*multiplierEMA + ema
                emas[i] = ema
        }

        // Calculate ATR (Average True Range)
        var tr = make([]float64, len(closes))

        // Calculate True Range
        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                tr[i] = max(
                        highs[i]-lows[i],
                        max(
                                math.Abs(highs[i]-closes[i-1]),
                                math.Abs(lows[i]-closes[i-1]),
                        ),
                )
        }

        // Calculate initial ATR as simple average of TR
        var atrSum float64
        for i := 1; i <= indicator.atrPeriod; i++ {
                atrSum += tr[i]
        }
        atr := atrSum / float64(indicator.atrPeriod)

        var atrs = make([]float64, len(closes))
        atrs[indicator.atrPeriod] = atr

        // Calculate subsequent ATR values
        for i := indicator.atrPeriod + 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                atr = ((atr * float64(indicator.atrPeriod-1)) + tr[i]) / float64(indicator.atrPeriod)
                atrs[i] = atr
        }

        // Calculate upper and lower bands
        var upperBand, lowerBand float64

        lastIndex := len(closes) - 1

        upperBand = emas[lastIndex] + indicator.multiplier*atrs[lastIndex]
        lowerBand = emas[lastIndex] - indicator.multiplier*atrs[lastIndex]

        return util.Round(upperBand), util.Round(emas[lastIndex]), util.Round(lowerBand)
}

func (indicator *KeltnerChannels) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["emaPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.emaPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.emaPeriod = 20 // default EMA period
        }

        if p, ok := config["atrPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.atrPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.atrPeriod = 10 // default ATR period
        }

        if m, ok := config["multiplier"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.multiplier = m
        } else {
                indicator.multiplier = 2.0 // default multiplier
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // Return the maximum range required
        maxPeriod := max(indicator.emaPeriod, indicator.atrPeriod)
        // We need maxPeriod+1 data points (due to the use of previous values) + offset
        return int32(maxPeriod + 1 + indicator.offset)
}

type Low struct {
        offset int
}

func (indicator *Low) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        if indicator.offset == 0 {
                return prices[len(prices)-1:]
        }
        return prices[len(prices)-1-indicator.offset : len(prices)-indicator.offset]
}

func (indicator *Low) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        offset := int(config[0].(float64))
        indicator.offset = offset

        prices := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "LOW")

        if len(prices) <= offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        return prices[len(prices)-1-offset]
}

func (indicator *Low) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        offset := indicator.offset
        if offset == 0 {
                if o, ok := config["offset"].(int); ok {
                        offset = o
                }
        }
        return int32(offset + 1)
}
package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type MACD struct {
        fastPeriod   int
        slowPeriod   int
        signalPeriod int
        offset       int
}

func (indicator *MACD) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate MACD properly
        // For MACD calculation we need at least 2*slowPeriod data points
        maxPeriod := max(indicator.slowPeriod, indicator.fastPeriod)
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*maxPeriod+indicator.signalPeriod))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

func (indicator *MACD) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        point := config[0].(string)
        fastPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        slowPeriod := int(config[2].(float64))
        signalPeriod := int(config[3].(float64))
        offset := int(config[4].(float64))

        indicator.fastPeriod = fastPeriod
        indicator.slowPeriod = slowPeriod
        indicator.signalPeriod = signalPeriod
        indicator.offset = offset

        prices := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, point)

        // Check if we have enough data points
        minDataPoints := indicator.slowPeriod + indicator.signalPeriod + indicator.offset
        if len(prices) < minDataPoints {
                return 0.0
        }

        prices = indicator.SliceData(prices)

        // Need at least slowPeriod data points to calculate
        if len(prices) < indicator.slowPeriod {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate fast EMA
        fastMultiplier := 2.0 / float64(indicator.fastPeriod+1)
        var fastSMA float64
        for i := 0; i < indicator.fastPeriod; i++ {
                fastSMA += prices[i]
        }
        fastSMA /= float64(indicator.fastPeriod)

        fastEMA := fastSMA
        var fastEMAs = make([]float64, len(prices))
        fastEMAs[indicator.fastPeriod-1] = fastEMA

        // Calculate slow EMA
        slowMultiplier := 2.0 / float64(indicator.slowPeriod+1)
        var slowSMA float64
        for i := 0; i < indicator.slowPeriod; i++ {
                slowSMA += prices[i]
        }
        slowSMA /= float64(indicator.slowPeriod)

        slowEMA := slowSMA
        var slowEMAs = make([]float64, len(prices))
        slowEMAs[indicator.slowPeriod-1] = slowEMA

        // Calculate fast and slow EMAs
        for i := indicator.fastPeriod; i < len(prices); i++ {
                fastEMA = prices[i]*fastMultiplier + fastEMA*(1-fastMultiplier)
                fastEMAs[i] = fastEMA
        }

        for i := indicator.slowPeriod; i < len(prices); i++ {
                slowEMA = prices[i]*slowMultiplier + slowEMA*(1-slowMultiplier)
                slowEMAs[i] = slowEMA
        }

        // Calculate MACD line
        var macdLine = make([]float64, len(prices))
        for i := indicator.slowPeriod - 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                macdLine[i] = fastEMAs[i] - slowEMAs[i]
        }

        // Calculate signal line using EMA of MACD line
        var signalLine = make([]float64, len(prices))
        signalMultiplier := 2.0 / float64(indicator.signalPeriod+1)

        // Calculate initial signal line value as SMA of MACD
        startIndex := indicator.slowPeriod + indicator.signalPeriod - 2
        var signalSMA float64
        for i := 0; i < indicator.signalPeriod; i++ {
                signalSMA += macdLine[indicator.slowPeriod-1+i]
        }
        signalSMA /= float64(indicator.signalPeriod)

        signalLine[startIndex] = signalSMA
        var signalEMA = signalSMA

        // Calculate subsequent signal line values
        for i := startIndex + 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                signalEMA = macdLine[i]*signalMultiplier + signalEMA*(1-signalMultiplier)
                signalLine[i] = signalEMA
        }

        // Calculate histogram (MACD line - signal line)
        var histogram = make([]float64, len(prices))
        for i := startIndex; i < len(prices); i++ {
                histogram[i] = macdLine[i] - signalLine[i]
        }

        // Return the last calculated MACD line value
        return util.Round(macdLine[len(macdLine)-1])
}

func (indicator *MACD) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["fastPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.fastPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.fastPeriod = 12 // default fast period
        }

        if p, ok := config["slowPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.slowPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.slowPeriod = 26 // default slow period
        }

        if p, ok := config["signalPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.signalPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.signalPeriod = 9 // default signal period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // Return the maximum data range required
        return int32(indicator.slowPeriod + indicator.signalPeriod + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type MFI struct {
        period int
        offset int
}

func (indicator *MFI) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate MFI properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *MFI) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes, volumes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate MFI properly
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end], volumes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *MFI) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        period := int(config[0].(float64))
        offset := int(config[1].(float64))

        indicator.period = period
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")
        volumes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "volume")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < period+offset+1 || len(lows) < period+offset+1 ||
                len(closes) < period+offset+1 || len(volumes) < period+offset+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes, volumes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes, volumes)

        // Need at least period+1 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < period+1 || len(lows) < period+1 ||
                len(closes) < period+1 || len(volumes) < period+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate typical price
        var typicalPrices = make([]float64, len(closes))
        for i := 0; i < len(closes); i++ {
                typicalPrices[i] = (highs[i] + lows[i] + closes[i]) / 3.0
        }

        // Calculate raw money flow
        var rawMoneyFlow = make([]float64, len(closes))
        for i := 0; i < len(closes); i++ {
                rawMoneyFlow[i] = typicalPrices[i] * volumes[i]
        }

        // Calculate positive and negative money flow
        var positiveMoneyFlow = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var negativeMoneyFlow = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                if typicalPrices[i] > typicalPrices[i-1] {
                        positiveMoneyFlow[i] = rawMoneyFlow[i]
                        negativeMoneyFlow[i] = 0.0
                } else if typicalPrices[i] < typicalPrices[i-1] {
                        positiveMoneyFlow[i] = 0.0
                        negativeMoneyFlow[i] = rawMoneyFlow[i]
                } else {
                        positiveMoneyFlow[i] = 0.0
                        negativeMoneyFlow[i] = 0.0
                }
        }

        // Calculate money flow ratio and MFI
        var mfi = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := period; i < len(closes); i++ {
                var sumPositiveFlow float64
                var sumNegativeFlow float64

                for j := i - period + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumPositiveFlow += positiveMoneyFlow[j]
                        sumNegativeFlow += negativeMoneyFlow[j]
                }

                // Avoid division by zero
                if sumNegativeFlow == 0 {
                        mfi[i] = 100.0
                } else {
                        moneyFlowRatio := sumPositiveFlow / sumNegativeFlow
                        mfi[i] = 100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + moneyFlowRatio))
                }
        }

        // Return the last calculated MFI value
        return util.Round(mfi[len(mfi)-1])
}

func (indicator *MFI) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["period"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.period = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.period = 14 // default period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // We need period+1 data points (due to the use of previous values) + offset
        return int32(indicator.period + 1 + indicator.offset)
}
