package parser

import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "math"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "unicode"
        instrument "algo/internal/modules/instrument/domain/model"
)

// TokenType represents different types of tokens in our grammar
type TokenType int

const (
        NUMBER TokenType = iota
        IDENTIFIER
        OPERATOR
        LPAREN
        RPAREN
        COMMA
        EOF
)

// Token represents a token in our lexical analysis
type Token struct {
        Type  TokenType
        Value string
}

// Lexer converts input string into tokens
type Lexer struct {
        input        string
        position     int
        readPosition int
        ch           byte
}

// NewLexer creates a new lexer for the given input
func NewLexer(input string) *Lexer {
        l := &Lexer{input: input}
        l.readChar()
        return l
}

// readChar reads the next character
func (l *Lexer) readChar() {
        if l.readPosition >= len(l.input) {
                l.ch = 0
        } else {
                l.ch = l.input[l.readPosition]
        }
        l.position = l.readPosition
        l.readPosition++
}

// peekChar returns the next character without advancing
func (l *Lexer) peekChar() byte {
        if l.readPosition >= len(l.input) {
                return 0
        }
        return l.input[l.readPosition]
}

// skipWhitespace skips any whitespace
func (l *Lexer) skipWhitespace() {
        for l.ch == ' ' || l.ch == '\t' || l.ch == '\n' || l.ch == '\r' {
                l.readChar()
        }
}

// NextToken returns the next token
func (l *Lexer) NextToken() Token {
        var tok Token

        l.skipWhitespace()

        switch l.ch {
        case '(':
                tok = Token{Type: LPAREN, Value: "("}
        case ')':
                tok = Token{Type: RPAREN, Value: ")"}
        case ',':
                tok = Token{Type: COMMA, Value: ","}
        case '+', '-', '*', '/', '%', '>', '<', '=', '!':
                // Handle operators
                if l.ch == '>' && l.peekChar() == '=' {
                        tok = Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: ">="}
                        l.readChar()
                } else if l.ch == '<' && l.peekChar() == '=' {
                        tok = Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: "<="}
                        l.readChar()
                } else if l.ch == '=' && l.peekChar() == '=' {
                        tok = Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: "=="}
                        l.readChar()
                } else if l.ch == '!' && l.peekChar() == '=' {
                        tok = Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: "!="}
                        l.readChar()
                } else {
                        tok = Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: string(l.ch)}
                }
        case 0:
                tok = Token{Type: EOF, Value: ""}
        default:
                if unicode.IsDigit(rune(l.ch)) {
                        return l.readNumber()
                } else if unicode.IsLetter(rune(l.ch)) || l.ch == '_' {
                        return l.readIdentifier()
                } else {
                        tok = Token{Type: EOF, Value: string(l.ch)}
                }
        }

        l.readChar()
        return tok
}

// readNumber reads a number token
func (l *Lexer) readNumber() Token {
        position := l.position
        for unicode.IsDigit(rune(l.ch)) {
                l.readChar()
        }

        // Handle decimal point
        if l.ch == '.' && unicode.IsDigit(rune(l.peekChar())) {
                l.readChar() // consume the '.'
                for unicode.IsDigit(rune(l.ch)) {
                        l.readChar()
                }
        }

        return Token{Type: NUMBER, Value: l.input[position:l.position]}
}

// readIdentifier reads an identifier token
func (l *Lexer) readIdentifier() Token {
        position := l.position
        for unicode.IsLetter(rune(l.ch)) || unicode.IsDigit(rune(l.ch)) || l.ch == '_' {
                l.readChar()
        }
        value := l.input[position:l.position]

        // Check for logical operators
        if strings.ToUpper(value) == "AND" || strings.ToUpper(value) == "OR" || strings.ToUpper(value) == "NOT" ||
                strings.ToUpper(value) == "CROSSESABOVE" || strings.ToUpper(value) == "CROSSESBELOW" {
                return Token{Type: OPERATOR, Value: strings.ToUpper(value)}
        }

        return Token{Type: IDENTIFIER, Value: value}
}

// AST Node types
type NodeType int

const (
        NUMBER_NODE NodeType = iota
        VARIABLE_NODE
        BINARY_OP_NODE
        UNARY_OP_NODE
        FUNCTION_CALL_NODE
)

// Node represents a node in the AST
type Node interface {
        Type() NodeType
        String() string
        Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error)
}

// NumberNode represents a numeric literal
type NumberNode struct {
        Value float64
}

func (n *NumberNode) Type() NodeType {
        return NUMBER_NODE
}

func (n *NumberNode) String() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("%v", n.Value)
}

func (n *NumberNode) Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error) {
        return n.Value, nil
}

// VariableNode represents a variable reference
type VariableNode struct {
        Name string
}

func (n *VariableNode) Type() NodeType {
        return VARIABLE_NODE
}

func (n *VariableNode) String() string {
        return n.Name
}

func (n *VariableNode) Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error) {
        if value, exists := ctx.Variables[n.Name]; exists {
                return value, nil
        }
        return 0, fmt.Errorf("variable not found: %s", n.Name)
}

// GetName returns the name of the variable
func (n *VariableNode) GetName() string {
        return n.Name
}

// BinaryOpNode represents a binary operation
type BinaryOpNode struct {
        Left     Node
        Operator string
        Right    Node
}

func (n *BinaryOpNode) Type() NodeType {
        return BINARY_OP_NODE
}

func (n *BinaryOpNode) String() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("(%s %s %s)", n.Left.String(), n.Operator, n.Right.String())
}

func (n *BinaryOpNode) Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error) {
        left, err := n.Left.Evaluate(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        right, err := n.Right.Evaluate(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        switch n.Operator {
        case "+":
                return left + right, nil
        case "-":
                return left - right, nil
        case "*":
                return left * right, nil
        case "/":
                if right == 0 {
                        return 0, errors.New("division by zero")
                }
                return left / right, nil
        case "%":
                if right == 0 {
                        return 0, errors.New("modulo by zero")
                }
                return math.Mod(left, right), nil
        case ">":
                if left > right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "CROSSESABOVE":
                d := (*ctx.Data)[0 : len(*ctx.Data)-1]
                prevLeft, err := n.Left.Evaluate(NewEvaluationContext(&d))

                if err != nil {
                        // TODO: handle err
                        return 0, nil
                }

                prevRight, err := n.Right.Evaluate(NewEvaluationContext(&d))

                if err != nil {
                        // TODO: handle err
                        return 0, nil
                }

                if (left > right) && (prevLeft <= prevRight) {
                        return 1, nil
                }

                return 0, nil
        case "<":
                if left < right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "CROSSESBELOW":
                d := (*ctx.Data)[0 : len(*ctx.Data)-1]
                prevLeft, err := n.Left.Evaluate(NewEvaluationContext(&d))

                if err != nil {
                        // TODO: handle err
                        return 0, nil
                }

                prevRight, err := n.Right.Evaluate(NewEvaluationContext(&d))

                if err != nil {
                        // TODO: handle err
                        return 0, nil
                }

                if (left < right) && (prevLeft >= prevRight) {
                        return 1, nil
                }

                return 0, nil
        case ">=":
                if left >= right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "<=":
                if left <= right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "==":
                if left == right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "!=":
                if left != right {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "AND":
                if left != 0 && right != 0 {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        case "OR":
                if left != 0 || right != 0 {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        default:
                return 0, fmt.Errorf("unknown operator: %s", n.Operator)
        }
}

// UnaryOpNode represents a unary operation
type UnaryOpNode struct {
        Operator string
        Operand  Node
}

func (n *UnaryOpNode) Type() NodeType {
        return UNARY_OP_NODE
}

func (n *UnaryOpNode) String() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s)", n.Operator, n.Operand.String())
}

func (n *UnaryOpNode) Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error) {
        operand, err := n.Operand.Evaluate(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        switch n.Operator {
        case "-":
                return -operand, nil
        case "+":
                return operand, nil
        case "NOT":
                if operand == 0 {
                        return 1, nil
                }
                return 0, nil
        default:
                return 0, fmt.Errorf("unknown unary operator: %s", n.Operator)
        }
}

// FunctionCallNode represents a function call
type FunctionCallNode struct {
        Name      string
        Arguments []Node
}

func (n *FunctionCallNode) Type() NodeType {
        return FUNCTION_CALL_NODE
}

func (n *FunctionCallNode) String() string {
        args := make([]string, len(n.Arguments))
        for i, arg := range n.Arguments {
                args[i] = arg.String()
        }
        return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s)", n.Name, strings.Join(args, ", "))
}

// EMA(close, 50, 0)

func (n *FunctionCallNode) Evaluate(ctx *EvaluationContext) (float64, error) {
        args := make([]any, len(n.Arguments))
        for i, arg := range n.Arguments {
                if varNode, isVariable := arg.(*VariableNode); isVariable {
                        args[i] = varNode.Name
                        continue
                }

                value, err := arg.Evaluate(ctx)
                if err != nil {
                        return 0, err
                }

                args[i] = value
        }

        calculator := GetIndFactory(n.Name)
        if calculator == nil {
                return 0, fmt.Errorf("unknown indicator: %s", n.Name)
        }

        result := calculator.Calculate(args, ctx)
        return result, nil
}

// Parser parses tokens into an AST
type Parser struct {
        lexer        *Lexer
        currentToken Token
        peekToken    Token
}

// NewParser creates a new parser
func NewParser(lexer *Lexer) *Parser {
        p := &Parser{lexer: lexer}
        p.nextToken() // Initialize currentToken
        p.nextToken() // Initialize peekToken
        return p
}

// nextToken advances to the next token
func (p *Parser) nextToken() {
        p.currentToken = p.peekToken
        p.peekToken = p.lexer.NextToken()
}

// ParseExpression parses an expression
func (p *Parser) ParseExpression() (Node, error) {
        return p.parseLogicalExpression()
}

// parseLogicalExpression parses logical expressions (AND, OR)
func (p *Parser) parseLogicalExpression() (Node, error) {
        left, err := p.parseComparison()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        for p.currentToken.Type == OPERATOR &&
                (p.currentToken.Value == "AND" || p.currentToken.Value == "OR") {
                operator := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                right, err := p.parseComparison()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                left = &BinaryOpNode{
                        Left:     left,
                        Operator: operator,
                        Right:    right,
                }
        }

        return left, nil
}

// parseComparison parses comparison expressions
func (p *Parser) parseComparison() (Node, error) {
        left, err := p.parseArithmeticExpression()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        if p.currentToken.Type == OPERATOR &&
                (p.currentToken.Value == ">" || p.currentToken.Value == "<" ||
                        p.currentToken.Value == ">=" || p.currentToken.Value == "<=" ||
                        p.currentToken.Value == "==" || p.currentToken.Value == "!=" ||
                        p.currentToken.Value == "CROSSESABOVE" || p.currentToken.Value == "CROSSESBELOW") {
                operator := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                right, err := p.parseArithmeticExpression()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                return &BinaryOpNode{
                        Left:     left,
                        Operator: operator,
                        Right:    right,
                }, nil
        }

        return left, nil
}

// parseArithmeticExpression parses arithmetic expressions (+ and -)
func (p *Parser) parseArithmeticExpression() (Node, error) {
        left, err := p.parseTerm()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        for p.currentToken.Type == OPERATOR &&
                (p.currentToken.Value == "+" || p.currentToken.Value == "-") {
                operator := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                right, err := p.parseTerm()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                left = &BinaryOpNode{
                        Left:     left,
                        Operator: operator,
                        Right:    right,
                }
        }

        return left, nil
}

// parseTerm parses terms (* and /)
func (p *Parser) parseTerm() (Node, error) {
        left, err := p.parseFactor()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        for p.currentToken.Type == OPERATOR &&
                (p.currentToken.Value == "*" || p.currentToken.Value == "/" || p.currentToken.Value == "%") {
                operator := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                right, err := p.parseFactor()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                left = &BinaryOpNode{
                        Left:     left,
                        Operator: operator,
                        Right:    right,
                }
        }

        return left, nil
}

// parseFactor parses factors
func (p *Parser) parseFactor() (Node, error) {
        if p.currentToken.Type == OPERATOR &&
                (p.currentToken.Value == "+" || p.currentToken.Value == "-" || p.currentToken.Value == "NOT") {
                operator := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                operand, err := p.parseFactor()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                return &UnaryOpNode{
                        Operator: operator,
                        Operand:  operand,
                }, nil
        }

        return p.parsePrimary()
}

// parsePrimary parses primary expressions
func (p *Parser) parsePrimary() (Node, error) {
        switch p.currentToken.Type {
        case NUMBER:
                value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(p.currentToken.Value, 64)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }
                node := &NumberNode{Value: value}
                p.nextToken()
                return node, nil

        case IDENTIFIER:
                identifier := p.currentToken.Value
                p.nextToken()

                // Check if it's a function call
                if p.currentToken.Type == LPAREN {
                        p.nextToken() // consume '('
                        args, err := p.parseArguments()
                        if err != nil {
                                return nil, err
                        }
                        return &FunctionCallNode{
                                Name:      identifier,
                                Arguments: args,
                        }, nil
                }

                // It's a variable reference
                return &VariableNode{Name: strings.ToUpper(identifier)}, nil

        case LPAREN:
                p.nextToken() // consume '('
                expr, err := p.parseLogicalExpression()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }

                if p.currentToken.Type != RPAREN {
                        return nil, errors.New("expected ')'")
                }
                p.nextToken() // consume ')'

                return expr, nil

        default:
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected token: %s", p.currentToken.Value)
        }
}

// parseArguments parses function arguments
func (p *Parser) parseArguments() ([]Node, error) {
        var args []Node

        // Handle empty argument list
        if p.currentToken.Type == RPAREN {
                p.nextToken() // consume ')'
                return args, nil
        }

        // Parse first argument
        arg, err := p.parseLogicalExpression()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
        args = append(args, arg)

        // Parse remaining arguments
        for p.currentToken.Type == COMMA {
                p.nextToken() // consume ','

                arg, err := p.parseLogicalExpression()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }
                args = append(args, arg)
        }

        if p.currentToken.Type != RPAREN {
                return nil, errors.New("expected ')' after function arguments")
        }
        p.nextToken() // consume ')'

        return args, nil
}

// TradingFunctions defines the interface for trading-specific functions
type TradingFunctions interface {
        SMA(value float64, period int) (float64, error)
        EMA(value float64, period int) (float64, error)
        RSI(period int) (float64, error)
        MACD(fastPeriod, slowPeriod, signalPeriod int) (float64, error)
        BollingerBandUpper(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error)
        BollingerBandLower(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error)
        BollingerBandMiddle(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error)
        ATR(period int) (float64, error)
        Stochastic(kPeriod, kSlowing, dPeriod int) (float64, error)
        CrossAbove(value1, value2 float64) (float64, error)
        CrossBelow(value1, value2 float64) (float64, error)
        PercentChange(current float64, periods int) (float64, error)
        Highest(value float64, period int) (float64, error)
        Lowest(value float64, period int) (float64, error)
}

// EvaluationContext holds the context for expression evaluation
type EvaluationContext struct {
        Data *instrument.StockData

        Variables map[string]float64
        // Functions TradingFunctions
}

// NewEvaluationContext creates a new evaluation context
func NewEvaluationContext(data *instrument.StockData) *EvaluationContext {
        return &EvaluationContext{
                Data: data,
                // Variables: vars,
                // Functions: funcs,
        }
}

// ExpressionBuilder allows building expressions programmatically
type ExpressionBuilder struct {
        root Node
}

// NewExpressionBuilder creates a new expression builder
func NewExpressionBuilder() *ExpressionBuilder {
        return &ExpressionBuilder{}
}

// Number creates a number node
func (b *ExpressionBuilder) Number(value float64) *NumberNode {
        return &NumberNode{Value: value}
}

// Variable creates a variable node
func (b *ExpressionBuilder) Variable(name string) *VariableNode {
        return &VariableNode{Name: strings.ToUpper(name)}
}

// BinaryOp creates a binary operation node
func (b *ExpressionBuilder) BinaryOp(left Node, operator string, right Node) *BinaryOpNode {
        return &BinaryOpNode{
                Left:     left,
                Operator: operator,
                Right:    right,
        }
}

// UnaryOp creates a unary operation node
func (b *ExpressionBuilder) UnaryOp(operator string, operand Node) *UnaryOpNode {
        return &UnaryOpNode{
                Operator: operator,
                Operand:  operand,
        }
}

// FunctionCall creates a function call node
func (b *ExpressionBuilder) FunctionCall(name string, args ...Node) *FunctionCallNode {
        return &FunctionCallNode{
                Name:      name,
                Arguments: args,
        }
}

// Parse parses an expression string
func Parse(expr string) (Node, error) {
        lexer := NewLexer(expr)
        parser := NewParser(lexer)
        return parser.ParseExpression()
}

// Execute evaluates an expression
func Execute(expr string, ctx *EvaluationContext) bool {
        node, err := Parse(expr)
        if err != nil {
                println("Error in parsing the expression: ", err)
                panic("parse expression error: ALERT ALERT ALERT!!!")
        }

        result, err := node.Evaluate(ctx)
        if err != nil {
                println("Error in evaluating the expression: ", err)
                panic("parse evaluation error: ALERT ALERT ALERT!!!")
        }

        return result > 0
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type ParabolicSAR struct {
        acceleration    float64
        maxAcceleration float64
        offset          int
}

func (indicator *ParabolicSAR) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Parabolic SAR properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+20)) // Use more data for trend identification
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *ParabolicSAR) sliceAllData(highs, lows Prices) (Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate Parabolic SAR properly
        // Need at least 2 data points + offset
        start := max(0, len(highs)-(indicator.offset+20)) // Use more data for trend identification
        end := len(highs) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(highs) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end]
}

func (indicator *ParabolicSAR) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        acceleration := float64(config[0].(float64))
        maxAcceleration := float64(config[1].(float64))
        offset := int(config[2].(float64))

        indicator.acceleration = acceleration
        indicator.maxAcceleration = maxAcceleration
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < 2+offset || len(lows) < 2+offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows)

        // Need at least 2 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < 2 || len(lows) < 2 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Initialize variables
        var sar = make([]float64, len(highs))
        var ep = make([]float64, len(highs)) // Extreme Point
        var af = make([]float64, len(highs)) // Acceleration Factor
        var isUptrend = make([]bool, len(highs))

        // Determine initial trend
        // Assuming uptrend initially for simplicity
        isUptrend[0] = true
        isUptrend[1] = highs[1] > highs[0]

        // Set initial extreme point (EP)
        if isUptrend[1] {
                ep[1] = highs[1]
                sar[1] = lows[0] // SAR starts at the lowest low of the previous period
        } else {
                ep[1] = lows[1]
                sar[1] = highs[0] // SAR starts at the highest high of the previous period
        }

        af[1] = indicator.acceleration // Start with the initial acceleration factor

        // Calculate SAR for the rest of the data
        for i := 2; i < len(highs); i++ {
                // Previous SAR
                sar[i] = sar[i-1]

                // If previous trend was up
                if isUptrend[i-1] {
                        // Check if current low is less than previous SAR (trend reversal)
                        if lows[i] < sar[i] {
                                // Trend changes to down
                                isUptrend[i] = false

                                // SAR becomes the previous extreme point
                                sar[i] = ep[i-1]

                                // Reset acceleration factor and set new extreme point
                                af[i] = indicator.acceleration
                                ep[i] = lows[i]
                        } else {
                                // Continue uptrend
                                isUptrend[i] = true

                                // Update SAR: SAR(today) = SAR(yesterday) + AF * (EP - SAR(yesterday))
                                sar[i] = sar[i-1] + af[i-1]*(ep[i-1]-sar[i-1])

                                // Ensure SAR is not higher than the lows of the two previous periods
                                sar[i] = min(sar[i], min(lows[i-1], lows[i-2]))

                                // Update extreme point if new high
                                if highs[i] > ep[i-1] {
                                        ep[i] = highs[i]
                                        // Increase acceleration factor, up to maximum
                                        af[i] = min(af[i-1]+indicator.acceleration, indicator.maxAcceleration)
                                } else {
                                        ep[i] = ep[i-1]
                                        af[i] = af[i-1]
                                }
                        }
                } else { // Previous trend was down
                        // Check if current high is greater than previous SAR (trend reversal)
                        if highs[i] > sar[i] {
                                // Trend changes to up
                                isUptrend[i] = true

                                // SAR becomes the previous extreme point
                                sar[i] = ep[i-1]

                                // Reset acceleration factor and set new extreme point
                                af[i] = indicator.acceleration
                                ep[i] = highs[i]
                        } else {
                                // Continue downtrend
                                isUptrend[i] = false

                                // Update SAR: SAR(today) = SAR(yesterday) + AF * (EP - SAR(yesterday))
                                sar[i] = sar[i-1] + af[i-1]*(ep[i-1]-sar[i-1])

                                // Ensure SAR is not lower than the highs of the two previous periods
                                sar[i] = max(sar[i], max(highs[i-1], highs[i-2]))

                                // Update extreme point if new low
                                if lows[i] < ep[i-1] {
                                        ep[i] = lows[i]
                                        // Increase acceleration factor, up to maximum
                                        af[i] = min(af[i-1]+indicator.acceleration, indicator.maxAcceleration)
                                } else {
                                        ep[i] = ep[i-1]
                                        af[i] = af[i-1]
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        // Return the last calculated SAR value
        return util.Round(sar[len(sar)-1])
}

func (indicator *ParabolicSAR) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if a, ok := config["acceleration"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.acceleration = a
        } else {
                indicator.acceleration = 0.02 // default initial acceleration
        }

        if m, ok := config["maxAcceleration"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.maxAcceleration = m
        } else {
                indicator.maxAcceleration = 0.2 // default maximum acceleration
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // We need at least 20 data points to establish a good trend + offset
        return int32(20 + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type SMA struct {
        period int
        offset int
}

func (indicator *SMA) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        start := len(prices) - indicator.offset - indicator.period
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset
        return prices[start:end]
}

// SMA(OHLCV, period, offset)
func (indicator *SMA) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        point := config[0].(string)
        period := int(config[1].(float64))
        offset := int(config[2].(float64))

        indicator.period = period
        indicator.offset = offset

        prices := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, point)

        println(point, period, offset)

        if len(prices) < period+offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate SMA
        var sum float64
        start := len(prices) - period - offset
        end := len(prices) - offset

        for i := start; i < end; i++ {
                sum += prices[i]
        }

        return util.Round(sum / float64(period))
}

func (indicator *SMA) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        period := indicator.period
        if period == 0 {
                if p, ok := config["period"].(int); ok {
                        period = p
                } else {
                        period = 14 // default period
                }
        }

        offset := indicator.offset
        if offset == 0 {
                if p, ok := config["period"].(int); ok {
                        offset = p
                } else {
                        offset = 0
                }
        }

        return int32(period + offset)
}
package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
        "math"
)

type Supertrend struct {
        period     int
        multiplier float64
        offset     int
}

func (indicator *Supertrend) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Supertrend properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Internal helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *Supertrend) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate Supertrend properly
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *Supertrend) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        period := int(config[0].(float64))
        multiplier := float64(config[1].(float64))
        offset := int(config[2].(float64))

        indicator.period = period
        indicator.multiplier = multiplier
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < period+offset || len(lows) < period+offset || len(closes) < period+offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes)

        // Need at least period data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < period || len(lows) < period || len(closes) < period {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate ATR (Average True Range)
        var atr = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var tr = make([]float64, len(closes))

        // Calculate True Range
        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                tr[i] = max(
                        highs[i]-lows[i],
                        max(
                                math.Abs(highs[i]-closes[i-1]),
                                math.Abs(lows[i]-closes[i-1]),
                        ),
                )
        }

        // Calculate initial ATR (simple average of TR for the first 'period' days)
        var sumTR float64
        for i := 1; i <= period; i++ {
                sumTR += tr[i]
        }
        atr[period] = sumTR / float64(period)

        // Calculate ATR using the smoothing technique
        for i := period + 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                atr[i] = (atr[i-1]*(float64(period)-1) + tr[i]) / float64(period)
        }

        // Calculate upper and lower bands
        var upperBand = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var lowerBand = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var supertrend = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var trend = make([]int, len(closes)) // 1 for up, -1 for down

        // Calculate initial bands
        for i := period; i < len(closes); i++ {
                basicUpperBand := (highs[i]+lows[i])/2 + indicator.multiplier*atr[i]
                basicLowerBand := (highs[i]+lows[i])/2 - indicator.multiplier*atr[i]

                // Set initial values
                if i == period {
                        upperBand[i] = basicUpperBand
                        lowerBand[i] = basicLowerBand
                        if closes[i] <= upperBand[i] {
                                supertrend[i] = lowerBand[i]
                                trend[i] = -1
                        } else {
                                supertrend[i] = upperBand[i]
                                trend[i] = 1
                        }
                        continue
                }

                // Adjust upper band
                if basicUpperBand < upperBand[i-1] || closes[i-1] > upperBand[i-1] {
                        upperBand[i] = basicUpperBand
                } else {
                        upperBand[i] = upperBand[i-1]
                }

                // Adjust lower band
                if basicLowerBand > lowerBand[i-1] || closes[i-1] < lowerBand[i-1] {
                        lowerBand[i] = basicLowerBand
                } else {
                        lowerBand[i] = lowerBand[i-1]
                }

                // Determine trend and supertrend value
                if supertrend[i-1] == upperBand[i-1] {
                        if closes[i] <= upperBand[i] {
                                supertrend[i] = upperBand[i]
                                trend[i] = -1
                        } else {
                                supertrend[i] = lowerBand[i]
                                trend[i] = 1
                        }
                } else { // supertrend[i-1] == lowerBand[i-1]
                        if closes[i] >= lowerBand[i] {
                                supertrend[i] = lowerBand[i]
                                trend[i] = 1
                        } else {
                                supertrend[i] = upperBand[i]
                                trend[i] = -1
                        }
                }
        }

        // Return the last calculated supertrend value
        return util.Round(supertrend[len(supertrend)-1])
}

func (indicator *Supertrend) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["period"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.period = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.period = 14 // default period
        }

        if m, ok := config["multiplier"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.multiplier = m
        } else {
                indicator.multiplier = 3.0 // default multiplier
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        return int32(indicator.period + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        "errors"
        "math"
)

// DefaultTradingFunctions provides implementations of trading functions
type DefaultTradingFunctions struct {
        // Historical data
        Prices     []float64 // Close prices
        OpenPrices []float64 // Open prices
        HighPrices []float64 // High prices
        LowPrices  []float64 // Low prices
        Volumes    []float64 // Volume data

        // Previous state (for cross detection)
        PreviousValues map[string]float64

        // Portfolio state
        PortfolioValue float64
        Cash           float64
        PositionSize   float64
        MarketPosition float64 // 0 = flat, positive = long, negative = short
        AvgEntryPrice  float64
}

// NewDefaultTradingFunctions creates a new instance of trading functions
func NewDefaultTradingFunctions() *DefaultTradingFunctions {
        return &DefaultTradingFunctions{
                PreviousValues: make(map[string]float64),
        }
}

// SMA calculates Simple Moving Average
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) SMA(value float64, period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for SMA calculation")
        }

        sum := 0.0
        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                sum += f.Prices[i]
        }

        return sum / float64(period), nil
}

// EMA calculates Exponential Moving Average
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) EMA(value float64, period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for EMA calculation")
        }

        // Calculate multiplier
        multiplier := 2.0 / (float64(period) + 1.0)

        // Start with SMA for the first period
        var ema float64
        sum := 0.0
        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                sum += f.Prices[i]
        }
        ema = sum / float64(period)

        // Apply EMA formula for subsequent periods
        for i := len(f.Prices) - period + 1; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                ema = (f.Prices[i]-ema)*multiplier + ema
        }

        return ema, nil
}

// RSI calculates Relative Strength Index
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) RSI(period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period+1 {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for RSI calculation")
        }

        // Calculate price changes
        changes := make([]float64, period)
        for i := 0; i < period; i++ {
                idx := len(f.Prices) - period - 1 + i
                changes[i] = f.Prices[idx+1] - f.Prices[idx]
        }

        // Calculate average gains and losses
        sumGain := 0.0
        sumLoss := 0.0
        for _, change := range changes {
                if change > 0 {
                        sumGain += change
                } else {
                        sumLoss += math.Abs(change)
                }
        }

        // Calculate RS and RSI
        avgGain := sumGain / float64(period)
        avgLoss := sumLoss / float64(period)

        if avgLoss == 0 {
                return 100, nil
        }

        rs := avgGain / avgLoss
        rsi := 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))

        return rsi, nil
}

// MACD calculates Moving Average Convergence Divergence
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) MACD(fastPeriod, slowPeriod, signalPeriod int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < slowPeriod+signalPeriod {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for MACD calculation")
        }

        // Calculate fast EMA
        fastEMA, err := f.EMA(0, fastPeriod)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        // Calculate slow EMA
        slowEMA, err := f.EMA(0, slowPeriod)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        // Calculate MACD line
        macdLine := fastEMA - slowEMA

        // For signal line, we would need historical MACD values
        // For simplicity, we return the MACD line value
        return macdLine, nil
}

// BollingerBandUpper calculates the upper Bollinger Band
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) BollingerBandUpper(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for Bollinger Bands calculation")
        }

        // Calculate SMA
        sma, err := f.SMA(0, period)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        // Calculate standard deviation
        sumSquaredDiff := 0.0
        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                diff := f.Prices[i] - sma
                sumSquaredDiff += diff * diff
        }

        standardDeviation := math.Sqrt(sumSquaredDiff / float64(period))

        // Upper band = SMA + (stdDev * standard deviation)
        upperBand := sma + (stdDev * standardDeviation)

        return upperBand, nil
}

// BollingerBandLower calculates the lower Bollinger Band
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) BollingerBandLower(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for Bollinger Bands calculation")
        }

        // Calculate SMA
        sma, err := f.SMA(0, period)
        if err != nil {
                return 0, err
        }

        // Calculate standard deviation
        sumSquaredDiff := 0.0
        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                diff := f.Prices[i] - sma
                sumSquaredDiff += diff * diff
        }

        standardDeviation := math.Sqrt(sumSquaredDiff / float64(period))

        // Lower band = SMA - (stdDev * standard deviation)
        lowerBand := sma - (stdDev * standardDeviation)

        return lowerBand, nil
}

// BollingerBandMiddle calculates the middle Bollinger Band (SMA)
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) BollingerBandMiddle(period int, stdDev float64) (float64, error) {
        return f.SMA(0, period)
}

// ATR calculates Average True Range
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) ATR(period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period+1 || len(f.HighPrices) < period+1 || len(f.LowPrices) < period+1 {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for ATR calculation")
        }

        // Calculate true ranges
        trueRanges := make([]float64, period)
        for i := 0; i < period; i++ {
                idx := len(f.Prices) - period - 1 + i

                // Calculate the three differences
                highLow := f.HighPrices[idx+1] - f.LowPrices[idx+1]
                highPrevClose := math.Abs(f.HighPrices[idx+1] - f.Prices[idx])
                lowPrevClose := math.Abs(f.LowPrices[idx+1] - f.Prices[idx])

                // True range is the maximum of the three
                trueRanges[i] = math.Max(highLow, math.Max(highPrevClose, lowPrevClose))
        }

        // Calculate average
        sum := 0.0
        for _, tr := range trueRanges {
                sum += tr
        }

        return sum / float64(period), nil
}

// Stochastic calculates the Stochastic Oscillator
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) Stochastic(kPeriod, kSlowing, dPeriod int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < kPeriod || len(f.HighPrices) < kPeriod || len(f.LowPrices) < kPeriod {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for Stochastic calculation")
        }

        // Find highest high and lowest low over lookback period
        highestHigh := math.Inf(-1)
        lowestLow := math.Inf(1)

        for i := len(f.Prices) - kPeriod; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                if f.HighPrices[i] > highestHigh {
                        highestHigh = f.HighPrices[i]
                }

                if f.LowPrices[i] < lowestLow {
                        lowestLow = f.LowPrices[i]
                }
        }

        // Calculate %K (Fast Stochastic)
        currentClose := f.Prices[len(f.Prices)-1]

        // Avoid division by zero
        if highestHigh == lowestLow {
                return 50, nil
        }

        percentK := (currentClose - lowestLow) / (highestHigh - lowestLow) * 100

        // For simplicity, we return %K value
        // A full implementation would also calculate %D (the SMA of %K)
        return percentK, nil
}

// CrossAbove checks if value1 crossed above value2 in the last bar
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) CrossAbove(value1, value2 float64) (float64, error) {
        // Generate unique key for storing previous values
        key := "crossabove"

        // If we don't have previous values, initialize them
        if _, exists := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"]; !exists {
                f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"] = 0
        }
        if _, exists := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"]; !exists {
                f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"] = 0
        }

        // Get previous values
        prevVal1 := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"]
        prevVal2 := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"]

        // Update previous values for next time
        f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"] = value1
        f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"] = value2

        // Check for cross above
        if prevVal1 <= prevVal2 && value1 > value2 {
                return 1, nil
        }

        return 0, nil
}

// CrossBelow checks if value1 crossed below value2 in the last bar
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) CrossBelow(value1, value2 float64) (float64, error) {
        // Generate unique key for storing previous values
        key := "crossbelow"

        // If we don't have previous values, initialize them
        if _, exists := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"]; !exists {
                f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"] = 0
        }
        if _, exists := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"]; !exists {
                f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"] = 0
        }

        // Get previous values
        prevVal1 := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"]
        prevVal2 := f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"]

        // Update previous values for next time
        f.PreviousValues[key+"_val1"] = value1
        f.PreviousValues[key+"_val2"] = value2

        // Check for cross below
        if prevVal1 >= prevVal2 && value1 < value2 {
                return 1, nil
        }

        return 0, nil
}

// PercentChange calculates the percentage change over a given period
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) PercentChange(current float64, periods int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < periods+1 {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for percent change calculation")
        }

        previousPrice := f.Prices[len(f.Prices)-periods-1]

        if previousPrice == 0 {
                return 0, errors.New("division by zero in percent change calculation")
        }

        percentChange := (current - previousPrice) / previousPrice * 100

        return percentChange, nil
}

// Highest returns the highest value over a given period
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) Highest(value float64, period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for highest calculation")
        }

        highest := math.Inf(-1)

        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                if f.Prices[i] > highest {
                        highest = f.Prices[i]
                }
        }

        return highest, nil
}

// Lowest returns the lowest value over a given period
func (f *DefaultTradingFunctions) Lowest(value float64, period int) (float64, error) {
        if len(f.Prices) < period {
                return 0, errors.New("not enough data for lowest calculation")
        }

        lowest := math.Inf(1)

        for i := len(f.Prices) - period; i < len(f.Prices); i++ {
                if f.Prices[i] < lowest {
                        lowest = f.Prices[i]
                }
        }

        return lowest, nil
}
package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
        "math"
)

type TSI struct {
        longPeriod   int
        shortPeriod  int
        signalPeriod int
        offset       int
}

func (indicator *TSI) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate TSI properly
        // For TSI calculation we need at least 2*(longPeriod + shortPeriod) data points
        totalPeriod := indicator.longPeriod + indicator.shortPeriod + indicator.signalPeriod
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*totalPeriod))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

func (indicator *TSI) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        point := config[0].(string)
        longPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        shortPeriod := int(config[2].(float64))
        signalPeriod := int(config[3].(float64))
        offset := int(config[4].(float64))

        indicator.longPeriod = longPeriod
        indicator.shortPeriod = shortPeriod
        indicator.signalPeriod = signalPeriod
        indicator.offset = offset

        prices := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, point)

        // Check if we have enough data points
        totalPeriod := longPeriod + shortPeriod + signalPeriod
        if len(prices) < totalPeriod+offset+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        prices = indicator.SliceData(prices)

        // Need at least totalPeriod+1 data points to calculate
        if len(prices) < totalPeriod+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate price changes (momentum)
        var momentum = make([]float64, len(prices))
        for i := 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                momentum[i] = prices[i] - prices[i-1]
        }

        // Calculate the first EMA of the momentum (long period)
        var ema1 = make([]float64, len(prices))
        multiplier1 := 2.0 / float64(indicator.longPeriod+1)

        // Calculate initial value as simple average
        var sumLong float64
        for i := 1; i <= indicator.longPeriod; i++ {
                sumLong += momentum[i]
        }
        ema1[indicator.longPeriod] = sumLong / float64(indicator.longPeriod)

        // Calculate subsequent values
        for i := indicator.longPeriod + 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                ema1[i] = (momentum[i]-ema1[i-1])*multiplier1 + ema1[i-1]
        }

        // Calculate the second EMA of the first EMA (short period)
        var ema2 = make([]float64, len(prices))
        multiplier2 := 2.0 / float64(indicator.shortPeriod+1)

        // Calculate initial value as simple average
        var sumShort float64
        startIdx := indicator.longPeriod + indicator.shortPeriod
        for i := indicator.longPeriod + 1; i <= startIdx; i++ {
                sumShort += ema1[i]
        }
        ema2[startIdx] = sumShort / float64(indicator.shortPeriod)

        // Calculate subsequent values
        for i := startIdx + 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                ema2[i] = (ema1[i]-ema2[i-1])*multiplier2 + ema2[i-1]
        }

        // Calculate the first EMA of the absolute momentum (long period)
        var absEma1 = make([]float64, len(prices))

        // Calculate initial value as simple average
        var absSum float64
        for i := 1; i <= indicator.longPeriod; i++ {
                absSum += math.Abs(momentum[i])
        }
        absEma1[indicator.longPeriod] = absSum / float64(indicator.longPeriod)

        // Calculate subsequent values
        for i := indicator.longPeriod + 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                absEma1[i] = (math.Abs(momentum[i])-absEma1[i-1])*multiplier1 + absEma1[i-1]
        }

        // Calculate the second EMA of the first absolute EMA (short period)
        var absEma2 = make([]float64, len(prices))

        // Calculate initial value as simple average
        var absSumShort float64
        for i := indicator.longPeriod + 1; i <= startIdx; i++ {
                absSumShort += absEma1[i]
        }
        absEma2[startIdx] = absSumShort / float64(indicator.shortPeriod)

        // Calculate subsequent values
        for i := startIdx + 1; i < len(prices); i++ {
                absEma2[i] = (absEma1[i]-absEma2[i-1])*multiplier2 + absEma2[i-1]
        }

        // Calculate TSI
        var tsi = make([]float64, len(prices))
        for i := startIdx; i < len(prices); i++ {
                // Avoid division by zero
                if absEma2[i] != 0 {
                        tsi[i] = 100 * (ema2[i] / absEma2[i])
                } else {
                        tsi[i] = 0
                }
        }

        // Calculate signal line (EMA of TSI)
        var signal = make([]float64, len(prices))
        multiplierSignal := 2.0 / float64(indicator.signalPeriod+1)

        // Calculate initial value as simple average
        var sumSignal float64
        signalStartIdx := startIdx + indicator.signalPeriod
        for i := startIdx; i < signalStartIdx; i++ {
                sumSignal += tsi[i]
        }
        signal[signalStartIdx-1] = sumSignal / float64(indicator.signalPeriod)

        // Calculate subsequent values
        for i := signalStartIdx; i < len(prices); i++ {
                signal[i] = (tsi[i]-signal[i-1])*multiplierSignal + signal[i-1]
        }

        // Return the last calculated TSI value
        return util.Round(tsi[len(tsi)-1])
}

func (indicator *TSI) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["longPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.longPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.longPeriod = 25 // default long period
        }

        if p, ok := config["shortPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.shortPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.shortPeriod = 13 // default short period
        }

        if p, ok := config["signalPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.signalPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.signalPeriod = 7 // default signal period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // We need (longPeriod + shortPeriod + signalPeriod) + 1 data points + offset
        totalPeriod := indicator.longPeriod + indicator.shortPeriod + indicator.signalPeriod
        return int32(totalPeriod + 1 + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type UltimateOscillator struct {
        shortPeriod int
        midPeriod   int
        longPeriod  int
        weightShort float64
        weightMid   float64
        weightLong  float64
        offset      int
}

func (indicator *UltimateOscillator) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Ultimate Oscillator properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.longPeriod))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *UltimateOscillator) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate Ultimate Oscillator properly
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.longPeriod))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *UltimateOscillator) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        shortPeriod := int(config[0].(float64))
        midPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        longPeriod := int(config[2].(float64))
        weightShort := float64(config[3].(float64))
        weightMid := float64(config[4].(float64))
        weightLong := float64(config[5].(float64))
        offset := int(config[6].(float64))

        indicator.shortPeriod = shortPeriod
        indicator.midPeriod = midPeriod
        indicator.longPeriod = longPeriod
        indicator.weightShort = weightShort
        indicator.weightMid = weightMid
        indicator.weightLong = weightLong
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < longPeriod+offset+1 || len(lows) < longPeriod+offset+1 || len(closes) < longPeriod+offset+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes)

        // Need at least longPeriod+1 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < longPeriod+1 || len(lows) < longPeriod+1 || len(closes) < longPeriod+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate buying pressure (BP) and true range (TR)
        var bp = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var tr = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                // Buying Pressure = Close - Minimum(Low, Previous Close)
                bp[i] = closes[i] - min(lows[i], closes[i-1])

                // True Range = Maximum(High, Previous Close) - Minimum(Low, Previous Close)
                tr[i] = max(highs[i], closes[i-1]) - min(lows[i], closes[i-1])
        }

        // Calculate Average7, Average14, and Average28
        var sumBPShort, sumTRShort float64
        var sumBPMid, sumTRMid float64
        var sumBPLong, sumTRLong float64

        // Calculate UO
        var uo = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := indicator.longPeriod; i < len(closes); i++ {
                // Reset sums for each period
                sumBPShort = 0
                sumTRShort = 0
                sumBPMid = 0
                sumTRMid = 0
                sumBPLong = 0
                sumTRLong = 0

                // Calculate short period sums
                for j := i - indicator.shortPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumBPShort += bp[j]
                        sumTRShort += tr[j]
                }

                // Calculate mid period sums
                for j := i - indicator.midPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumBPMid += bp[j]
                        sumTRMid += tr[j]
                }

                // Calculate long period sums
                for j := i - indicator.longPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumBPLong += bp[j]
                        sumTRLong += tr[j]
                }

                // Calculate averages
                var average7, average14, average28 float64

                // Avoid division by zero
                if sumTRShort > 0 {
                        average7 = sumBPShort / sumTRShort
                }

                if sumTRMid > 0 {
                        average14 = sumBPMid / sumTRMid
                }

                if sumTRLong > 0 {
                        average28 = sumBPLong / sumTRLong
                }

                // Calculate Ultimate Oscillator
                totalWeight := indicator.weightShort + indicator.weightMid + indicator.weightLong
                uo[i] = 100 * ((indicator.weightShort*average7 +
                        indicator.weightMid*average14 +
                        indicator.weightLong*average28) / totalWeight)
        }

        // Return the last calculated Ultimate Oscillator value
        return util.Round(uo[len(uo)-1])
}

func (indicator *UltimateOscillator) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["shortPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.shortPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.shortPeriod = 7 // default short period
        }

        if p, ok := config["midPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.midPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.midPeriod = 14 // default mid period
        }

        if p, ok := config["longPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.longPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.longPeriod = 28 // default long period
        }

        if w, ok := config["weightShort"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.weightShort = w
        } else {
                indicator.weightShort = 4.0 // default weight for short period
        }

        if w, ok := config["weightMid"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.weightMid = w
        } else {
                indicator.weightMid = 2.0 // default weight for mid period
        }

        if w, ok := config["weightLong"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.weightLong = w
        } else {
                indicator.weightLong = 1.0 // default weight for long period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // We need longPeriod+1 data points (due to the use of previous values) + offset
        return int32(indicator.longPeriod + 1 + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type VolumeOscillator struct {
        shortPeriod int
        longPeriod  int
        offset      int
}

func (indicator *VolumeOscillator) SliceData(volumes Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Volume Oscillator properly
        start := max(0, len(volumes)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.longPeriod))
        end := len(volumes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(volumes) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return volumes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *VolumeOscillator) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        shortPeriod := int(config[0].(float64))
        longPeriod := int(config[1].(float64))
        offset := int(config[2].(float64))

        indicator.shortPeriod = shortPeriod
        indicator.longPeriod = longPeriod
        indicator.offset = offset

        volumes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "volume")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(volumes) < longPeriod+offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        volumes = indicator.SliceData(volumes)

        // Need at least longPeriod data points to calculate
        if len(volumes) < longPeriod {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate short-term SMA of volume
        var shortSMA = make([]float64, len(volumes))

        // For each point, calculate SMA for the short period
        for i := indicator.shortPeriod - 1; i < len(volumes); i++ {
                var sum float64
                for j := i - indicator.shortPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sum += volumes[j]
                }
                shortSMA[i] = sum / float64(indicator.shortPeriod)
        }

        // Calculate long-term SMA of volume
        var longSMA = make([]float64, len(volumes))

        // For each point, calculate SMA for the long period
        for i := indicator.longPeriod - 1; i < len(volumes); i++ {
                var sum float64
                for j := i - indicator.longPeriod + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sum += volumes[j]
                }
                longSMA[i] = sum / float64(indicator.longPeriod)
        }

        // Calculate Volume Oscillator
        var vo = make([]float64, len(volumes))
        for i := indicator.longPeriod - 1; i < len(volumes); i++ {
                // Avoid division by zero
                if longSMA[i] != 0 {
                        vo[i] = 100 * ((shortSMA[i] - longSMA[i]) / longSMA[i])
                } else {
                        vo[i] = 0
                }
        }

        // Return the last calculated Volume Oscillator value
        return util.Round(vo[len(vo)-1])
}

func (indicator *VolumeOscillator) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["shortPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.shortPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.shortPeriod = 5 // default short period
        }

        if p, ok := config["longPeriod"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.longPeriod = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.longPeriod = 10 // default long period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        return int32(indicator.longPeriod + indicator.offset)
}

type Volume struct {
        offset int
}

func (indicator *Volume) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        if indicator.offset == 0 {
                return prices[len(prices)-1:]
        }
        return prices[len(prices)-1-indicator.offset : len(prices)-indicator.offset]
}

func (indicator *Volume) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        offset := config[0].(int)
        indicator.offset = offset

        prices := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "VOLUME")

        if len(prices) <= offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        return prices[len(prices)-1-offset]
}

func (indicator *Volume) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        offset := indicator.offset
        if offset == 0 {
                if o, ok := config["offset"].(int); ok {
                        offset = o
                }
        }
        return int32(offset + 1)
}

type Vortex struct {

        offset int
}

func (indicator *Vortex) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate Vortex indicator properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Internal helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *Vortex) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate Vortex indicator properly
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+2*indicator.period))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *Vortex) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        period := int(config[0].(float64))
        offset := int(config[1].(float64))

        indicator.period = period
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < period+offset+1 || len(lows) < period+offset+1 || len(closes) < period+offset+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes)

        // Need at least period+1 data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < period+1 || len(lows) < period+1 || len(closes) < period+1 {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate VM+ and VM- for each bar
        var vmPlus = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var vmMinus = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var tr = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := 1; i < len(closes); i++ {
                // VM+ = |Current High - Prior Low|
                vmPlus[i] = math.Abs(highs[i] - lows[i-1])

                // VM- = |Current Low - Prior High|
                vmMinus[i] = math.Abs(lows[i] - highs[i-1])

                // Calculate True Range
                tr[i] = max(
                        highs[i]-lows[i],
                        max(
                                math.Abs(highs[i]-closes[i-1]),
                                math.Abs(lows[i]-closes[i-1]),
                        ),
                )
        }

        // Calculate Vortex Indicator
        var viPlus = make([]float64, len(closes))
        var viMinus = make([]float64, len(closes))

        for i := period; i < len(closes); i++ {
                // Calculate sum of VM+ for period
                var sumVMPlus float64
                for j := i - period + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumVMPlus += vmPlus[j]
                }

                // Calculate sum of VM- for period
                var sumVMMinus float64
                for j := i - period + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumVMMinus += vmMinus[j]
                }

                // Calculate sum of TR for period
                var sumTR float64
                for j := i - period + 1; j <= i; j++ {
                        sumTR += tr[j]
                }

                // Calculate VI+ and VI-
                viPlus[i] = sumVMPlus / sumTR
                viMinus[i] = sumVMMinus / sumTR
        }

        // Return the last calculated VI+ value
        return util.Round(viPlus[len(viPlus)-1])
}

func (indicator *Vortex) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["period"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.period = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.period = 14 // default period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        // We need period+1 data points (due to the use of previous values) + offset
        return int32(indicator.period + 1 + indicator.offset)
}

package parser

import (
        util "algo/internal/util/math"
)

type VWAP struct {
        period int
        offset int
}

func (indicator *VWAP) SliceData(prices Prices) Prices {
        // We need enough data to calculate VWAP properly
        start := max(0, len(prices)-(indicator.offset+indicator.period))
        end := len(prices) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(prices) {
                return Prices{}
        }

        return prices[start:end]
}

// Helper method to slice all required data
func (indicator *VWAP) sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes, volumes Prices) (Prices, Prices, Prices, Prices) {
        // We need enough data to calculate VWAP properly
        start := max(0, len(closes)-(indicator.offset+indicator.period))
        end := len(closes) - indicator.offset

        if start < 0 || end <= start || end > len(closes) {
                return Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}, Prices{}
        }

        return highs[start:end], lows[start:end], closes[start:end], volumes[start:end]
}

func (indicator *VWAP) Calculate(
        config []any,
        ctx *EvaluationContext,
) float64 {
        period := int(config[0].(float64))
        offset := int(config[1].(float64))

        indicator.period = period
        indicator.offset = offset

        highs := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "high")
        lows := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "low")
        closes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "close")
        volumes := GetPrices(*ctx.Data, "volume")

        // Check if we have enough data points
        if len(highs) < period+offset || len(lows) < period+offset ||
                len(closes) < period+offset || len(volumes) < period+offset {
                return 0.0
        }

        highs, lows, closes, volumes = indicator.sliceAllData(highs, lows, closes, volumes)

        // Need at least period data points to calculate
        if len(highs) < period || len(lows) < period ||
                len(closes) < period || len(volumes) < period {
                return 0.0
        }

        // Calculate typical price
        var typicalPrices = make([]float64, len(closes))
        for i := 0; i < len(closes); i++ {
                typicalPrices[i] = (highs[i] + lows[i] + closes[i]) / 3.0
        }

        // Calculate VWAP
        var cumulativeTPV float64 // Typical Price * Volume
        var cumulativeVolume float64
        var vwap = make([]float64, len(closes))

        // Calculate for the lookback period
        for i := len(closes) - period; i < len(closes); i++ {
                cumulativeTPV += typicalPrices[i] * volumes[i]
                cumulativeVolume += volumes[i]

                // Avoid division by zero
                if cumulativeVolume > 0 {
                        vwap[i] = cumulativeTPV / cumulativeVolume
                } else {
                        vwap[i] = 0.0
                }
        }

        // Return the last calculated VWAP value
        return util.Round(vwap[len(vwap)-1])
}

func (indicator *VWAP) GetDataRange(config map[string]any) int32 {
        if p, ok := config["period"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.period = int(p)
        } else {
                indicator.period = 14 // default period
        }

        if o, ok := config["offset"].(float64); ok {
                indicator.offset = int(o)
        } else {
                indicator.offset = 0
        }

        return int32(indicator.period + indicator.offset)
}

// CreateStrategyRequest represents the request to create a new strategy
type CreateStrategyRequest struct {
        Name                 string               `json:"name" validate:"required,min=3,max=100" db:"name"`
        Description          string               `json:"description" validate:"max=500" db:"description"`
        PositionType         model.Direction      `json:"position_type" validate:"required,oneof=LONG SHORT BOTH" db:"position_type"`
        Instruments          pq.Int32Array        `json:"instruments" validate:"required,min=1,dive,gt=0" db:"instruments"`
        ChartType            model.ChartType      `json:"chart_type" validate:"required,oneof=CANDLESTICK HEIKINASHI RENKO" db:"chart_type"`
        ChartTimeframe       model.ChartTimeframe `json:"chart_timeframe" validate:"required,oneof=1m 3m 5m 15m 1h 1d" db:"chart_timeframe"`
        TradeType            model.TradeType      `json:"trade_type" validate:"required,oneof=MIS CNC/NRML" db:"trade_type"`
        Qty                  int                  `json:"qty" validate:"required,gt=0" db:"qty"`
        EntryExpression      string               `json:"entry_expression" validate:"required" db:"entry_expression"`
        ExitExpression       string               `json:"exit_expression" db:"exit_expression"`
        TargetProfit         *float64             `json:"target_profit" validate:"required,gte=0" db:"target_profit"`
        TargetProfitType     *model.ValueType     `json:"target_profit_type" validate:"required,oneof=ABSOLUTE PERCENTAGE" db:"target_profit_type"`
        StopLoss             *float64             `json:"stop_loss" validate:"required,gte=0" db:"stop_loss"`
        StopLossType         *model.ValueType     `json:"stop_loss_type" validate:"required,oneof=ABSOLUTE PERCENTAGE" db:"stop_loss_type"`
        TrailingStopLoss     *float64             `json:"trailing_stop_loss" validate:"omitempty,gte=0" db:"trailing_stop_loss"`
        TrailingStopLossType *model.ValueType     `json:"trailing_stop_loss_type" validate:"omitempty,oneof=ABSOLUTE PERCENTAGE" db:"trailing_stop_loss_type"`
        ExitType             *string              `json:"exit_type" db:"exit_type"`
        Capital              *float64             `json:"capital" validate:"required,gt=0" db:"capital"`
        MaxTrades            *int                 `json:"max_trades" validate:"omitempty,gt=0" db:"max_trades"`
        EntryStartTime       *time.Time           `json:"entry_start_time" db:"entry_start_time"`
        EntryEndTime         *time.Time           `json:"entry_end_time" db:"entry_end_time"`
        StartDate            *time.Time           `json:"start_date" db:"start_date"`
        EndDate              *time.Time           `json:"end_date" db:"end_date"`
}

        StopLossType         model.ValueType      `json:"stop_loss_type,omitempty" db:"stop_loss_type"`
        TrailingStopLoss     float64              `json:"trailing_stop_loss,omitempty" db:"trailing_stop_loss"`
        TrailingStopLossType model.ValueType      `json:"trailing_stop_loss_type,omitempty" db:"trailing_stop_loss_type"`
        ExitType             string               `json:"exit_type,omitempty" db:"exit_type"`
        Capital              float64              `json:"capital,omitempty" db:"capital"`
        MaxTrades            int                  `json:"max_trades,omitempty" db:"max_trades"`

// StrategyFilter represents filters for searching strategies
type StrategyFilter struct {
        UserID         *uuid.UUID            `json:"user_id" db:"user_id"`
        Name           *string               `json:"name" db:"name"`
        PositionType   *model.Direction      `json:"position_type" db:"position_type"`
